```ts
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// `blur` is a gaussian applied to the distance field: no filters, no extra passes.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [480, 220],
    background: 0x050507,
    controls: {
        blur: { type: 'range', label: 'blur (σ)', min: 0, max: 30, step: 0.5, value: 12, unit: 'px' },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();

        stage.addChild(g);
        tick((t) => {
            const pulse = 0.8 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.2;

            g.clear();
            // neon: a blurred copy under a crisp stroke
            g.circle(110, 110, 60).stroke({ width: 8, color: 0xff375f, blur: params.blur * pulse, alpha: 0.9 });
            g.circle(110, 110, 60).stroke({ width: 3, color: 0xffd1dc });
            // soft shadow: offset, blurred, translucent
            g.roundRect(260, 60 + 18, 180, 100, 24, 0.6).fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.9, blur: params.blur });
            g.roundRect(260, 60, 180, 100, 24, 0.6).fill(0x2c2c2e);
            g.circle(300, 110, 16).fill({ color: 0x30d158, blur: params.blur * 0.4 });
            g.circle(300, 110, 7).fill(0xe8ffe8);
        });
    },
});
```

```ts
g.circle(110, 110, 60).stroke({ width: 8, color: 0xff375f, blur: 12, alpha: 0.9 }); // glow
g.circle(110, 110, 60).stroke({ width: 3, color: 0xffd1dc });                        // core
```

The first ring is blurred, the second is drawn sharp on top. `blur` is the standard deviation of a
gaussian, in local units. Silk blurs the shape's distance to its edge, so a blurred shape costs
what a sharp one does. Its quad grows by three times the blur.

## Drop a soft shadow

```ts
g.roundRect(20, 20 + 18, 180, 100, 24, 0.6).fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.45, blur: 24 });
g.roundRect(20, 20, 180, 100, 24, 0.6).fill(0x1c1c1e);
```

Offset, blur and fade a dark copy, then draw the shape. The Live Activity cards on the
[Showcase](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/showcase/) use this pattern, measured from the reference: blur 30.5, 37.5 px
down, 45% black.

A CSS shadow's blur radius is twice the standard deviation. Halve a CSS blur to get `blur`.

## Grow a glow with spread

Live demo `effects-spread` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Blur versus blur with spread, the white-square glow from the design tutorials.
// Spread grows the shape before the blur, so the glow keeps a bright core.
const STEPS = [
    { label: 'shape', glows: [] },
    { label: 'blur 8', glows: [{ blur: 8, spread: 0 }] },
    {
        label: 'blur 32, spread 8',
        glows: [
            { blur: 8, spread: 0 },
            { blur: 32, spread: 8 },
        ],
    },
    {
        label: 'blur 128, spread 32',
        glows: [
            { blur: 8, spread: 0 },
            { blur: 32, spread: 8 },
            { blur: 128, spread: 32 },
        ],
    },
];

export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 300],
    background: 0x111111,
    controls: {
        scale: { type: 'range', label: 'glow', min: 0, max: 1.5, step: 0.01, value: 1 },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();
        let last = -1;

        stage.addChild(g);
        STEPS.forEach((step, i) => {
            const t = new Text({
                text: step.label,
                style: { fill: 0x8e8e93, fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace', fontSize: 11 },
            });

            t.anchor.set(0.5, 0);
            t.position.set(95 + i * 150, 222);
            stage.addChild(t);
        });
        tick(() => {
            if (params.scale === last) return;
            last = params.scale;
            g.clear();
            STEPS.forEach((step, i) => {
                const x = 60 + i * 150;
                const k = params.scale;

                for (const glow of step.glows) {
                    // each glow layer is 1/4 of the blur in sigma (Figma blur is a diameter-ish radius)
                    g.roundRect(x, 105, 70, 70, 8).fill({
                        color: 0xffffff,
                        alpha: 0.9,
                        blur: (glow.blur / 4) * k,
                        spread: glow.spread * k * 0.7,
                        blend: 'add',
                    });
                }
                g.roundRect(x, 105, 70, 70, 8).fill(0xffffff);
            });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

```ts
g.rect(0, 0, 80, 80).fill({ color: 0xffffff, blur: 16, spread: 8, blend: 'add' });
g.rect(0, 0, 80, 80).fill(0xffffff);
```

`spread` grows the shape by that many local units before the blur, like a Figma shadow spread.
The glow keeps a bright core instead of fading straight from the edge. Negative values shrink the
shape. Stacking a tight glow and a wide one reads better than one large blur.

`blend: 'add'` paints plus-lighter: colours add to what is underneath, so overlapping glows bloom
towards white. It stays in the same draw as the other shapes.

## Add inner shadows

Live demo `effects-inner-shadow` (source):

```ts
import { type InnerShadow, SilkGraphics, vertical } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// The four inner shadows of a glowing app icon, straight from a Figma spec.
// Each one is an extra instance of the same shape, so the icon stays one draw call.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [560, 360],
    background: 0x1d1f22,
    controls: {
        deep: { type: 'toggle', label: 'blue 0, -80', value: true },
        soft: { type: 'toggle', label: 'light 0, -40', value: true },
        rim: { type: 'toggle', label: 'white, plus lighter', value: true },
        lip: { type: 'toggle', label: 'blue 0, 6', value: true },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();
        const body = vertical([0x0a0909, 0x09101f]);
        let key = '';

        stage.addChild(g);
        tick(() => {
            const next = `${params.deep}${params.soft}${params.rim}${params.lip}`;

            if (next === key) return;
            key = next;
            g.clear();
            // drop shadow under the icon
            g.roundRect(186, 92, 188, 188, 40).fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.55, blur: 18, spread: -6 });
            const shadows: (InnerShadow | false)[] = [
                params.deep && { color: 0x144ccd, x: 0, y: -40, blur: 30, spread: -15 },
                params.soft && { color: 0x6694ff, alpha: 0.5, x: 0, y: -20, blur: 15, spread: -4 },
                params.rim && { color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.4, x: 0, y: -10, blur: 10, spread: -3, blend: 'add' },
                params.lip && { color: 0x2365ff, alpha: 0.15, x: 0, y: 3, blur: 3, spread: -1 },
            ];

            g.roundRect(180, 80, 200, 200, 40).fill({
                gradient: body,
                innerShadow: shadows.filter((s): s is InnerShadow => s !== false),
            });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

```ts
g.roundRect(0, 0, 200, 200, 40).fill({
    color: 0x0a0909,
    innerShadow: [
        { color: 0x144ccd, y: -40, blur: 30, spread: -15 },
        { color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.4, y: -10, blur: 10, spread: -3, blend: 'add' },
    ],
});
```

An inner shadow moves a copy of the shape, shrinks it by `spread` and blurs it. What the copy no
longer covers is shaded. Shadows draw in order on top of the fill, gradients included, and a
`stroke()` after the fill lands on top of them. Inner shadows work on closed shapes.

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | black | Shadow colour |
| `alpha` | 1 | Opacity, 0 to 1 |
| `x`, `y` | 0 | Offset in local units. Positive moves right and down. |
| `blur` | 0 | Gaussian standard deviation, in local units |
| `spread` | 0 | Grows the shadow inwards. Negative makes it thinner. |
| `blend` | `'normal'` | `'add'` brightens what is underneath |

The option names follow Figma's inner shadow, so a spec ports over option by option.

## Blur progressively

Live demo `effects-progressive` (source):

```ts
import { SilkGraphics, vertical } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Progressive blur: the violet hill is sharp at its bottom edge and melts at the top. The white
// bloom under it is painted plus-lighter, so where they overlap the violet lifts towards white.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [560, 380],
    background: 0x111111,
    controls: {
        top: { type: 'range', label: 'blur at top', min: 0, max: 80, step: 1, value: 48 },
        bottom: { type: 'range', label: 'blur at bottom', min: 0, max: 20, step: 1, value: 1 },
        bloom: { type: 'toggle', label: 'plus-lighter bloom', value: true },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();
        const violet = vertical([0x6a3cf0, 0x4b22c9]);
        let drawn = '';

        stage.addChild(g);
        tick((t) => {
            const sway = Math.sin(t * 0.6) * 0.04;
            const key = `${params.top}|${params.bottom}|${params.bloom}|${sway.toFixed(3)}`;

            if (key === drawn) return;
            drawn = key;
            g.clear();
            g.roundRect(80, 30, 400, 320, 18).fill(0x1c1c1e);
            g.save()
                .translateTransform(290, 245)
                .rotateTransform(-0.22 + sway)
                .ellipse(0, 0, 240, 112)
                .fill({ gradient: violet, blur: { from: params.top, to: params.bottom } })
                .restore();
            if (params.bloom) {
                g.ellipse(300, 318, 150, 30).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.5, blur: 18, blend: 'add' });
                g.ellipse(300, 318, 80, 12).fill({ color: 0xf6efff, alpha: 0.55, blur: 8, blend: 'add' });
            }
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

```ts
g.area(points, 350, { smooth: 'monotone' }).fill({
    color: 0x5b2ee0,
    blur: { from: 20, to: 1, angle: Math.PI / 2 },
});
```

A `ProgressiveBlur` changes the blur across the shape. `from` is the blur at the start edge and
`to` at the far edge, along `angle` in radians. The default angle, `Math.PI / 2`, runs from top to
bottom.

## Limits

The blur is exact on straight edges and close on corners. Large blurs on complex paths, or on
the results of [shape operations](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shape-operations/), can round inner corners a little. For
those, a Pixi `BlurFilter` over the object still works. With `createSilkApp`, filters render at
the screen resolution.

Blurred paints are dithered like gradients, so a large soft shadow does not band. See
[Gradients](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/gradients/#banding).

---

# Glass and glow

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/glass-and-glow/
Section: Paint

> Frosted glass that blurs and bends what is behind it, and neon light that adds up to white, from the pixi-silk/glass and pixi-silk/glow entry points.

`pixi-silk/glass` draws panes of frosted glass over your scene. `pixi-silk/glow` stacks blurred
passes of one shape into neon light. Both are separate entry points, not part of the root import.

Live demo `glass-playground` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { Glass } from 'pixi-silk/glass';
import { trackGesture } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gesture';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const BLOBS = [0xff2d55, 0xff9f0a, 0x30d158, 0x0a84ff, 0xbf5af2];

export default defineDemo({
    size: [720, 460],
    background: 0x0a0a0c,
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        blur: { type: 'range', label: 'blur', min: 0, max: 48, step: 1, value: 18 },
        refraction: { type: 'range', label: 'refraction', min: -30, max: 40, step: 1, value: 16 },
        dispersion: { type: 'range', label: 'dispersion', min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01, value: 0.4 },
        frost: { type: 'range', label: 'frost', min: 0, max: 0.6, step: 0.01, value: 0.06 },
        light: { type: 'range', label: 'light', min: -180, max: 180, step: 1, value: -135, unit: '°' },
        grain: { type: 'range', label: 'grain', min: 0, max: 0.15, step: 0.005, value: 0.035 },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const back = new SilkGraphics();
        const blobs = new SilkGraphics();
        const lines = new SilkGraphics();
        const words = new Container();
        const glass = new Glass({ width: 300, height: 190, radius: 34 });
        const hint = new Text({
            text: 'drag me',
            style: { fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 14, fill: 0xffffff, fontWeight: '600' },
            alpha: 0.85,
        });
        let grab: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;

        blobs.blendMode = 'add';
        back.rect(0, 0, 720, 460).fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.001 });
        for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) lines.rect(0, 40 + i * 48, 720, 1.5).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.18 });
        ['PIXI', 'SILK', 'GLASS'].forEach((w, i) => {
            const t = new Text({
                text: w,
                style: { fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 96, fontWeight: '800', fill: 0xffffff },
            });

            t.alpha = 0.9;
            t.position.set(40 + i * 230, 150 + (i % 2) * 70);
            words.addChild(t);
        });
        hint.anchor.set(0.5);
        hint.position.set(150, 95);
        glass.content.addChild(hint);
        glass.position.set(210, 135);
        glass.eventMode = 'static';
        glass.cursor = 'grab';
        stage.addChild(back, blobs, lines, words, glass);

        trackGesture(
            glass,
            {
                onDown: (p) => (grab = { x: p.x - glass.x, y: p.y - glass.y }),
                onDrag: (p) => grab && glass.position.set(p.x - grab.x, p.y - grab.y),
                onUp: () => (grab = null),
            },
            { space: stage },
        );

        tick((t) => {
            blobs.clear();
            BLOBS.forEach((c, i) => {
                const a = t * (0.25 + i * 0.05) + i * 1.3;

                blobs
                    .circle(360 + Math.cos(a) * (220 - i * 18), 230 + Math.sin(a * 1.3) * 130, 90 - i * 6)
                    .fill({ color: c, alpha: 0.9, blur: 40 });
            });
            glass.set({
                blur: params.blur,
                refraction: params.refraction,
                dispersion: params.dispersion,
                frost: params.frost,
                lightAngle: (params.light * Math.PI) / 180,
                grain: params.grain,
            });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

```ts

const card = new Glass({ width: 300, height: 190, radius: 34, blur: 18, refraction: 16, dispersion: 0.4 });

card.content.addChild(new Text({ text: 'Frosted', style: { fill: 0xffffff } }));
card.set({ lightAngle: -Math.PI / 4, grain: 0.05 });
app.stage.addChild(card); // after the scene it frosts
```

The pane reads whatever is drawn behind it, blurs it and bends it along the curved rim. Labels and
icons go in `card.content`, which draws on top of the glass and stays sharp. `set()` changes
options later.

## Glass options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width`, `height` | 240, 160 | Pane size. The top-left corner is at (0, 0). |
| `radius` | 28 | Corner radius |
| `smoothing` | 0.6 | Squircle corners, 0 (circular) to 1 |
| `blur` | 18 | Backdrop blur radius |
| `refraction` | 14 | How far the rim bends the backdrop. Negative bends inwards. |
| `dispersion` | 0.35 | Colour split at the rim, 0 to 1 |
| `bevel` | 22 | Width of the curved rim |
| `frost` | 0.06 | Milky whitening, 0 to 1 |
| `saturation` | 1.2 | Colour boost of what shows through |
| `tint`, `tintAmount` | white, 0.04 | Coloured glass |
| `opacity` | 1 | Overall opacity |
| `lightAngle`, `light` | top left, 0.8 | Where the sheen comes from, in radians, and how bright it is |
| `grain` | 0.035 | Film grain |
| `shadow` | 0.3 | Soft shadow under the pane. 0 turns it off. |

## Where glass stops

The pane needs the canvas behind it. On WebGL, `Glass` turns on the renderer's back buffer the
first time it draws, so the first frame shows a plain pane. Pass `useBackBuffer: true` to
`createSilkApp` to have glass from the first frame. WebGPU reads the backdrop without a back
buffer. On any other renderer the pane draws a plain frosted fill.

Add the pane after the scene it frosts, since it only sees what is already drawn. It stays axis
aligned: scale it freely, but do not rotate it.

## Make neon with Glow

Live demo `glow-neon` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { linear, radial, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { bolt, Glow, neon } from 'pixi-silk/glow';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const YELLOW = 0xffd60a;
const font = 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';

export default defineDemo({
    size: [760, 440],
    background: 0x0b0b09,
    controls: {
        intensity: { type: 'range', label: 'glow', min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.05, value: 1 },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const room = new SilkGraphics();

        // warm light spilling into the room, like the reference backdrop
        room.rect(0, 0, 760, 440).fill(
            radial(
                [
                    [0, 0x3a3410, 1],
                    [0.55, 0x15140c, 1],
                    [1, 0x0b0b09, 1],
                ],
                { center: [0.28, 0.4], radius: 0.75 },
            ),
        );

        // the bolt alone: about 120 wide, so the recipe runs at size 120
        const big = new Glow({ draw: (g) => bolt(g, -60, -84, 120, 168), layers: neon(YELLOW, { size: 120 }) });

        big.position.set(190, 220);

        // the ticket card
        const card = new Container();
        const back = new SilkGraphics();
        const ticket = new SilkGraphics();
        const ring = new SilkGraphics();
        const small = new Glow({ draw: (g) => bolt(g, -52, -74, 104, 148), layers: neon(YELLOW, { size: 104 }) });

        // translucent yellow folder behind the ticket
        back.roundRect(0, 0, 230, 250, 18, 0.6)
            .fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.6, blur: 30, spread: 6 })
            .roundRect(0, 0, 230, 250, 18, 0.6)
            .fill({
                gradient: linear(
                    [
                        [0, 0x8a7d1c, 0.95],
                        [1, 0x4f4710, 0.95],
                    ],
                    { from: [0, 0], to: [0, 1] },
                ),
                innerShadow: { color: 0xfff6b0, alpha: 0.25, y: 1, blur: 1 },
            });
        small.position.set(118, 50);
        // the white ticket with a notch where the ring sits
        ticket
            .beginPath()
            .moveTo(14, 160)
            .lineTo(146, 160)
            .bezierCurveTo(160, 160, 160, 176, 176, 176)
            .lineTo(244, 176)
            .bezierCurveTo(252, 176, 258, 182, 258, 190)
            .lineTo(258, 300)
            .bezierCurveTo(258, 308, 252, 314, 244, 314)
            .lineTo(14, 314)
            .bezierCurveTo(6, 314, 0, 308, 0, 300)
            .lineTo(0, 174)
            .bezierCurveTo(0, 166, 6, 160, 14, 160)
            .closePath()
            .fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.55, blur: 18, spread: 2 })
            .fill({
                gradient: linear(
                    [
                        [0, 0xf4f5f0, 1],
                        [1, 0xc9ccd2, 1],
                    ],
                    { from: [0, 0], to: [0.3, 1] },
                ),
                innerShadow: { color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.9, y: 1, blur: 0.5 },
            });
        for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) {
            const w = [1, 2, 1, 3, 1, 2][i % 6];

            ticket.rect(22 + i * 4.6, 284, w, 12).fill({ color: 0x1d2a3a, alpha: 0.85 });
        }
        const title = new Text({
            text: 'Supercharged', // prose-ignore: copy from the design reference
            style: { fontFamily: font, fontSize: 23, fontWeight: '700', fill: 0x18181b },
        });
        const sub = new Text({
            text: 'Experience network speed\nlike never before',
            style: { fontFamily: font, fontSize: 11.5, fill: 0x52525b, lineHeight: 16 },
        });

        title.position.set(22, 222);
        sub.position.set(22, 252);
        ring.position.set(206, 172);
        card.addChild(back, small, ticket, ring, title, sub);
        card.position.set(445, 60);
        stage.addChild(room, big, card);

        let last = -1;

        tick((t) => {
            const flicker = 0.92 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 7.3) * Math.sin(t * 2.1);

            if (params.intensity !== last) {
                last = params.intensity;
                big.setLayers(neon(YELLOW, { size: 120, intensity: params.intensity }));
                small.setLayers(neon(YELLOW, { size: 104, intensity: params.intensity }));
            }
            big.alpha = flicker;
            ring.clear()
                .circle(0, 0, 30)
                .stroke({ width: 12, color: YELLOW, alpha: 0.75 * params.intensity, blur: 9, blend: 'add' })
                .circle(0, 0, 30)
                .stroke({ width: 3.5, color: 0xfff27a, blur: 0.8 })
                .circle(0, 0, 30)
                .stroke({ width: 2, color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.9, blur: 3, blend: 'add' });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

```ts

const spark = new Glow({
    draw: (g) => bolt(g, -50, -70, 100, 140),
    layers: neon(0xffd60a, { size: 100 }),
});
```

`Glow` draws one shape several times, once per layer, each with its own fill, stroke, blend and
offset. `neon()` returns the five-layer recipe for a shape about `size` wide. Two blooms go behind
it. The core has a gradient, coloured drop glows and a pale inner shadow. A white copy added on top
burns the middle out, and a blurred white outline finishes it.

| `neon()` option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | 100 | Rough size of the shape. Every blur scales with it. |
| `intensity` | 1 | Strength of the bloom, 0 to about 2 |
| `core` | a radial gradient | Paint of the solid core |
| `surface` | `'dark'` | On `'light'` surfaces the passes paint normally, since added light would vanish on white |

`bolt()` and `drop()` add ready outlines. Any path works in `draw`, because a fill treats a path
as one shape.

## Light that adds up

Light does not cover what is under it, it adds to it. Set `blendMode = 'add'` on a graphics, or
`blend: 'add'` on one fill, and overlapping glows burn towards white. Figma calls this Plus
lighter. With a `blur` on the fill, a soft light is one ellipse.

Live demo `glow-button` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { along, linear, radial, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { trackGesture } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gesture';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const W = 400;
const H = 128;

/** Point at `u` (0..1) around a pill centred at (0, 0), clockwise from the middle of its right end. */
function onPill(u: number): [number, number] {
    const r = H / 2;
    const straight = W - H;
    const total = 2 * straight + 2 * Math.PI * r;
    let d = (((u % 1) + 1) % 1) * total;

    if (d < Math.PI * r * 0.5) {
        const a = d / r;

        return [straight / 2 + Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r];
    }
    d -= Math.PI * r * 0.5;
    if (d < straight) return [straight / 2 - d, r];
    d -= straight;
    if (d < Math.PI * r) {
        const a = Math.PI / 2 + d / r;

        return [-straight / 2 + Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r];
    }
    d -= Math.PI * r;
    if (d < straight) return [-straight / 2 + d, -r];
    d -= straight;
    const a = -Math.PI / 2 + d / r;

    return [straight / 2 + Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r];
}

/** The border as an open path: it starts at `u0` and stops short of closing, leaving a gap. */
function border(u0: number, gap: number): number[] {
    const out: number[] = [];
    const n = 220;

    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) out.push(...onPill(u0 + (i / n) * (1 - gap)));

    return out;
}

export default defineDemo({
    size: [620, 360],
    background: 0x05061a,
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        const room = new SilkGraphics();
        const button = new Container();
        const bloom = new SilkGraphics();
        const body = new SilkGraphics();
        const line = new SilkGraphics();
        const dust = new SilkGraphics();
        const label = new Text({
            text: 'Magic button',
            style: { fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 34, fontWeight: '500', fill: 0xe4e2f4 },
        });
        // violet on the long run of the border, cooling to teal at its head
        const tube = along([
            [0, 0xffffff, 0],
            [0.08, 0xd9c8ff, 1],
            [0.55, 0xffffff, 1],
            [0.85, 0xc8f4ff, 1],
            [1, 0x7cf7e8, 0.9],
        ]);
        const halo = along([
            [0, 0x8b3dff, 0],
            [0.15, 0x9b4dff, 1],
            [0.5, 0x6d5bff, 1],
            [0.8, 0x3d8bff, 1],
            [1, 0x2ee6d6, 1],
        ]);
        const dots = Array.from({ length: 70 }, (_, i) => ({
            x: (((i * 0.618034) % 1) - 0.5) * 340,
            y: ((((i * 0.7548777 + 0.31) * 7) % 1) - 0.5) * 90,
            r: 0.6 + ((i * 31) % 10) / 10,
            p: i * 1.37,
        }));
        let hover = 0;
        let hot = 0;
        let burst = 0;
        let head = 0;

        room.rect(0, 0, 620, 360).fill(
            radial(
                [
                    [0, 0x1a1060, 1],
                    [0.6, 0x0a0a2c, 1],
                    [1, 0x05061a, 1],
                ],
                { center: [0.45, 0.5], radius: 0.8 },
            ),
        );
        bloom.blendMode = 'add';
        line.blendMode = 'add';
        dust.blendMode = 'add';
        label.anchor.set(0.5);
        button.position.set(310, 180);
        button.addChild(bloom, body, dust, line, label);
        button.eventMode = 'static';
        button.cursor = 'pointer';
        button.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => Math.abs(x) <= W / 2 && Math.abs(y) <= H / 2 };
        button.on('pointerover', () => (hot = 1));
        button.on('pointerout', () => (hot = 0));
        trackGesture(button, { onTap: () => (burst = 1) });
        stage.addChild(room, button);

        body.pill(-W / 2, -H / 2, W, H).fill({
            gradient: linear(
                [
                    [0, 0x1d1a8a, 1],
                    [1, 0x0f1150, 1],
                ],
                { from: [0, 0], to: [0, 1] },
            ),
            innerShadow: [
                { color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.45, y: 18, blur: 22, spread: 4 },
                { color: 0x8f7bff, alpha: 0.35, y: -2, blur: 6, blend: 'add' },
            ],
        });

        tick((t, dt) => {
            hover += (hot - hover) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
            burst = Math.max(0, burst - dt * 1.4);
            head += dt * (0.05 + hover * 0.12 + burst * 0.4);
            const glow = 0.8 + hover * 0.3 + burst * 0.7;
            const pts = border(head, 0.035);

            bloom
                .clear()
                .pill(-W / 2, -H / 2, W, H)
                .fill({ color: 0x5b3dff, alpha: 0.35 * glow, blur: 60, spread: 10 })
                .polyline(pts)
                .stroke({ width: 26, gradient: halo, alpha: 0.75 * glow, blur: 16 });
            line.clear()
                .polyline(pts)
                .stroke({ width: 12, gradient: halo, alpha: glow, blur: 4 })
                .polyline(pts)
                .stroke({ width: 5, gradient: tube, cap: 'round' })
                .polyline(pts)
                .stroke({ width: 3, gradient: tube, alpha: 0.6, blur: 1.5 });
            // a star of light sits on the head of the border
            const [hx, hy] = onPill(head + 0.965);

            line.circle(hx, hy, 18)
                .fill({ color: 0xbffff6, alpha: 0.5 * glow, blur: 14 })
                .star(hx, hy, 4, 28 * glow, 1.2, 0, 0)
                .fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.5, blur: 2 });
            dust.clear();
            for (const d of dots) {
                const a = (0.25 + 0.75 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 1.6 + d.p)) ** 4) * (0.5 + hover * 0.5 + burst);

                dust.circle(d.x, d.y, d.r).fill({ color: 0xc7d2ff, alpha: Math.min(1, a * 0.7), blur: 0.4 });
            }
            button.scale.set(1 + burst * 0.03);
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

The border of this button is an open path. Its head leaves a gap with a star of light in it.

Live demo `glow-icons` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { linear, radial, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { bolt, drop } from 'pixi-silk/glow';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const S = 176;

interface Palette {
    lead: number;
    mid: number;
    deep: number;
    rim: number;
    accent: number;
}

const PALETTES: Record<string, Palette> = {
    violet: { lead: 0x56d8ff, mid: 0x5636ff, deep: 0x2a0d73, rim: 0xc8f6ff, accent: 0xff4060 },
    sunset: { lead: 0xffe45c, mid: 0xff5a36, deep: 0xc0129a, rim: 0xfff4c2, accent: 0xb43cff },
    ice: { lead: 0x8af4ff, mid: 0x2d7dff, deep: 0x5b2bff, rim: 0xeaffff, accent: 0x7c4dff },
};

type Draw = (g: SilkGraphics) => SilkGraphics;

/**
 * A big shape that runs off the tile, the direction its light travels (lead edge to trailing side)
 * and how far along its box the colour has faded out.
 */
const ICONS: [Draw, angle: number, reach: number][] = [
    // bolt, cut by the top and right edges, lit from its left notch
    [(g) => bolt(g, 34, -46, 168, 236), 0, 1],
    // a dome rising from the bottom right corner, lit along its rim
    [(g) => g.circle(S * 1.02, S * 1.04, S * 0.8), Math.PI / 4, 0.5],
    // a drop sitting on the bottom edge, lit from the left
    [(g) => drop(g, S * 0.5, S * 1.02, S * 0.4, S * 0.66), -Math.PI / 6, 1],
    // a zigzag wall, lit along its left edge
    [
        (g) =>
            g.poly([S * 0.96, -10, S * 0.3, S * 0.4, S * 0.74, S * 0.6, S * 0.5, S + 10, S + 10, S + 10, S + 10, -10]),
        0,
        0.8,
    ],
];

export default defineDemo({
    size: [440, 440],
    background: 0x08080a,
    controls: {
        palette: { type: 'select', label: 'palette', options: Object.keys(PALETTES), value: 'violet' },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const arts: SilkGraphics[] = [];

        ICONS.forEach((_, i) => {
            const tile = new Container();
            const plate = new SilkGraphics();
            const clip = new SilkGraphics();
            const art = new SilkGraphics();
            const rim = new SilkGraphics();

            plate.roundRect(0, 0, S, S, 42, 0.6).fill(
                radial(
                    [
                        [0, 0x16161c, 1],
                        [1, 0x0a0a0d, 1],
                    ],
                    { center: [0.3, 0.2], radius: 1.1 },
                ),
            );
            clip.roundRect(0, 0, S, S, 42, 0.6).fill(0xffffff);
            art.mask = clip;
            // a thin glassy rim on top of the art, brighter where the light is
            rim.roundRect(0.5, 0.5, S - 1, S - 1, 42, 0.6).stroke({
                width: 1.4,
                gradient: linear(
                    [
                        [0, 0xffffff, 0.32],
                        [0.5, 0xffffff, 0.06],
                        [1, 0xffffff, 0.2],
                    ],
                    { from: [0, 0], to: [1, 1] },
                ),
                alignment: 'inside',
            });
            tile.addChild(plate, art, clip, rim);
            tile.position.set(30 + (i % 2) * (S + 28), 30 + Math.floor(i / 2) * (S + 28));
            stage.addChild(tile);
            arts.push(art);
        });

        let last = '';

        tick(() => {
            if (params.palette === last) return;
            last = params.palette;
            const p = PALETTES[params.palette];

            ICONS.forEach(([draw, angle, reach], i) => {
                const art = arts[i];
                const dx = Math.cos(angle);
                const dy = Math.sin(angle);
                const from: [number, number] = [0.5 - dx * 0.5, 0.5 - dy * 0.5];
                const to: [number, number] = [0.5 + dx * 0.5, 0.5 + dy * 0.5];
                const body = linear(
                    [
                        [0, p.lead, 1],
                        [0.3 * reach, p.mid, 1],
                        [0.7 * reach, p.deep, 0.85],
                        [reach, p.deep, 0],
                    ],
                    { from, to },
                );

                art.clear();
                // bloom that spills past the lit edge
                draw(art).fill({ gradient: body, alpha: 0.45, blur: 20, spread: 6, blend: 'add' });
                // the body: crisp on the lit side, dissolving towards the trailing side
                draw(art).fill({ gradient: body, blur: { from: 0.8, to: 46 * reach, angle }, blend: 'add' });
                // the lit edge: a shadow pushed towards the trailing side leaves a bright band along the lead
                draw(art).fill({
                    color: 0x000000,
                    alpha: 0,
                    innerShadow: [
                        { color: p.rim, alpha: 0.8, x: dx * 4, y: dy * 4, blur: 1.5, blend: 'add' },
                        { color: p.lead, alpha: 0.45, x: dx * 16, y: dy * 16, blur: 9, blend: 'add' },
                    ],
                });
                // a warm or cool kick where the lit edge meets the tile
                art.circle(S * (0.5 - dx * 0.35), S * 0.98, 26).fill({
                    color: p.accent,
                    alpha: 0.35,
                    blur: 18,
                    blend: 'add',
                });
            });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

Each icon is a large shape clipped by its tile. Its blur grows from the lit edge to the far side,
and an inner shadow pushed away from the light leaves a bright rim.

`Aurora` rises light in three colours from the bottom of a box and drifts slowly. `ray()`, `fan()`
and `spectrum()` build beams and prisms. The [Showcase](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/showcase/) has the full scenes made
with them.

---

# Text

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/text/
Section: Text

> SilkText draws labels and readouts from a runtime SDF glyph atlas, with outlines, glows, gradients and tabular numbers. It lives in pixi-silk/text.

`SilkText` from `pixi-silk/text` draws a string from distance-field glyphs, so a label under a
zooming camera keeps its edges where PixiJS `Text` turns into a stretched bitmap.

## Draw a label

Live demo `sdf-text` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Graphics, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkText } from 'pixi-silk/text';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Left: PixiJS Text, a bitmap drawn once. Right: SilkText, distance fields drawn per pixel.
// Both zoom around the same point, from 1x to 100x.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [520, 260],
    background: 0x0b0b0d,
    controls: {
        zoom: { type: 'range', label: 'zoom (log)', min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.01, value: 0, unit: '' },
        auto: { type: 'toggle', label: 'animate', value: true },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const half = 260;
        const sides: Container[] = [];
        const style = { fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '600' as const };

        for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            const side = new Container();
            const mask = new Graphics().rect(i * half, 0, half, 260).fill(0xffffff);
            const make = (text: string, size: number, color: number) =>
                i === 0
                    ? new Text({ text, style: { ...style, fontSize: size, fill: color } })
                    : new SilkText({ text, ...style, fontSize: size, fill: color });
            const title = make('Zoom 42%', 13, 0xffffff);
            const body = make('Labels, readouts and editor text', 9, 0x8e8e93);
            const tiny = make('W 128  H 64', 6, 0x0a84ff);

            title.position.set(70, 112);
            body.position.set(70, 132);
            tiny.position.set(70, 146);
            side.addChild(title, body, tiny);
            side.mask = mask;
            sides.push(side);
            const caption = new Text({
                text: i ? 'SilkText' : 'Text',
                style: { fill: 0x8e8e93, fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'system-ui' },
            });

            caption.position.set(i * half + 12, 10);
            stage.addChild(side, mask, caption);
        }
        stage.addChild(new Graphics().rect(half - 0.5, 0, 1, 260).fill(0x2c2c2e));
        const readout = new SilkText({
            ...style,
            fontSize: 12,
            fill: 0x8e8e93,
            tabularNumbers: true,
            anchor: { x: 1, y: 0 },
        });

        readout.position.set(508, 10);
        stage.addChild(readout);

        let t = 0;

        tick((_t, dt) => {
            if (params.auto) {
                t += dt;
                // ease in and out between 1x and 100x every 12 s
                params.zoom = 1 - Math.cos((t / 12) * Math.PI * 2);
            }
            const k = 10 ** params.zoom;
            // zoom into the "4" of the title
            const fx = 70 + 44;
            const fy = 112 + 9;

            sides.forEach((side, i) => {
                side.pivot.set(fx, fy);
                side.position.set(i * half + 130, 130);
                side.scale.set(k);
            });
            readout.text = `${k.toFixed(1)}x`;
        });
    },
});
```

```ts

const label = new SilkText({
    text: 'Frame 1',
    fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif',
    fontSize: 13,
    fontWeight: 600,
    fill: 0xffffff,
    anchor: 0.5,
});

app.stage.addChild(label);
label.text = 'Frame 2'; // laid out again before the next frame
```

PixiJS `Text` draws the string once into a canvas and shows that as a texture. SilkText stores
each glyph as a signed distance field instead, and the shader turns the distance into coverage per
screen pixel. [How it works](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/how-it-works/) covers the idea. All texts share one atlas texture.

Change one field with its setter (`label.fontSize = 18`) or several with `label.set({ ... })`.
Width, height, bounds and hit tests use the text box, as with PixiJS `Text`.

## Add an outline, a glow or a gradient

Live demo `sdf-text-styles` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { horizontal, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { SilkText } from 'pixi-silk/text';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Outline, glow, shadow, weight and a gradient all read the same distance field: no filters,
// still one draw call per text. Bottom left: small sizes at 1x, Text above SilkText.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [520, 320],
    background: 0x101014,
    controls: {
        outline: { type: 'range', label: 'outline', min: 0, max: 6, step: 0.5, value: 3, unit: 'px' },
        glow: { type: 'range', label: 'glow', min: 0, max: 12, step: 0.5, value: 8, unit: 'px' },
        dilate: { type: 'range', label: 'weight', min: -1.5, max: 1.5, step: 0.1, value: 0, unit: 'px' },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const font = 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';
        const card = new SilkGraphics()
            .roundRect(300, 176, 200, 124, 22, 0.6)
            .fill(0x1c1c1e)
            .roundRect(20, 176, 260, 124, 22, 0.6)
            .fill(0x1c1c1e);
        const outlined = new SilkText({
            text: 'OUTLINE',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 44,
            fontWeight: 900,
            fill: 0xffd60a,
            outline: { width: 3, color: 0x3a1c00 },
            shadow: { color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.6, blur: 6, offsetY: 4 },
        });
        const neon = new SilkText({
            text: 'Neon glow',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 40,
            fontWeight: 700,
            fill: 0xffe3f1,
            shadow: { color: 0xff2d92, blur: 8 },
        });
        const gradient = new SilkText({
            text: 'Gradient fill',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 30,
            fontWeight: 800,
            fill: horizontal(['#64d2ff', '#bf5af2', '#ff375f']),
        });
        const readout = new SilkText({
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 40,
            fontWeight: 600,
            fill: 0xffffff,
            tabularNumbers: true,
            anchor: { x: 1, y: 0 },
        });
        const unit = new SilkText({
            text: 'BPM  live',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: 600,
            fill: 0xff375f,
        });

        outlined.position.set(20, 20);
        neon.position.set(300, 26);
        gradient.position.set(20, 100);
        readout.position.set(480, 196);
        unit.position.set(320, 270);
        stage.addChild(card, outlined, neon, gradient, readout, unit);

        // small sizes at 1x: PixiJS Text above, SilkText below
        const sample = 'Hamburgefonstiv 0123';

        [11, 12, 13].forEach((size, i) => {
            const y = 190 + i * 34;
            const pixi = new Text({ text: sample, style: { fontFamily: font, fontSize: size, fill: 0xe5e5ea } });
            const silk = new SilkText({ text: sample, fontFamily: font, fontSize: size, fill: 0xe5e5ea });
            const tag = new SilkText({ text: `${size}px`, fontFamily: font, fontSize: 9, fill: 0x8e8e93 });

            pixi.position.set(64, y);
            silk.position.set(64, y + 15);
            tag.position.set(34, y + 9);
            stage.addChild(pixi, silk, tag);
        });

        tick((t) => {
            outlined.outline = params.outline > 0 ? { width: params.outline, color: 0x3a1c00 } : null;
            neon.shadow =
                params.glow > 0 ? { color: 0xff2d92, blur: params.glow * (0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(t * 3)) } : null;
            for (const text of [outlined, neon, gradient]) text.dilate = params.dilate;
            readout.text = (72 + 6 * Math.sin(t * 1.3) + 2 * Math.sin(t * 4.1)).toFixed(1);
        });
    },
});
```

An outline or a glow reads the same distance field at a different distance, so it needs no filter.

```ts

const title = new SilkText({
    text: 'BIG WIN',
    fontSize: 48,
    fontWeight: 900,
    fill: horizontal(['#ffd60a', '#ff9f0a']),
    outline: { width: 3, color: 0x3a1c00 },
    shadow: { color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.6, blur: 6, offsetY: 4 },
});
const readout = new SilkText({ text: '72.4', fontSize: 32, tabularNumbers: true });
```

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fontFamily`, `fontSize`, `fontWeight`, `fontStyle` | system UI font, 16, 400, normal | Any CSS font. Glyphs are baked once at a fixed size |
| `fill` | white | A colour, or a linear, radial or conic gradient over the text box |
| `letterSpacing`, `lineHeight` | 0, font | Spacing in local units. Line height 0 uses the font's own |
| `align`, `wordWrap`, `wordWrapWidth`, `breakWords` | left, off, 100, off | Line layout, as in PixiJS `Text` |
| `anchor` | 0 | Point of the text box at the position |
| `outline` | none | `{ width, color, alpha }`, outside the glyph edge |
| `shadow` | none | `{ color, alpha, blur, offsetX, offsetY }`. Without an offset it is a glow |
| `dilate` | 0 | Grows or thins the glyphs, in local units |
| `tabularNumbers` | off | Digits share one width, so a changing number does not jitter |
| `kerning` | on | Pair kerning measured from Canvas |

Outlines and glows reach about a quarter of the font size. Past that the distance field runs out
and the effect is clamped. For a wider halo, put a blurred SilkGraphics shape behind the text.

## Small sizes

At 11 to 13 px a texel of the atlas is smaller than a screen pixel. SilkText then averages four
samples per pixel, so thin stems do not flicker. The bottom left of the first demo shows both
kinds of text at 11, 12 and 13 px.

Glyph shapes and widths match PixiJS `Text`, because both come from the same Canvas font and
`measureText`. Some platforms hint Canvas text to the pixel grid, so at 1x and no zoom its stems
can look a little crisper. From 2x, or under a camera, SilkText wins.

## Use SilkText inside widgets

Widgets that show a value take a `label` option, a function that builds their text. Pass
`silkLabel()` for widgets that sit under a zooming camera. The widget never imports SilkText
itself, so apps that do not use it do not ship it.

```ts

const pill = new ValuePill({ label: silkLabel({ tabularNumbers: true }) });

pill.show('42 px');
```

To let people click and type into a text, wrap it in a `TextEditor`. See [Editing text](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editing-text/).

## Fonts and the atlas

Each glyph is drawn with Canvas2D at 48 px the first time it appears, then turned into a distance
field. The atlas is one 8-bit texture, 1024 texels wide, that doubles in height up to 4096. When it
is full it starts over, and every text bakes what it needs again.

Load web fonts before the first text uses them, for example with `document.fonts.load('600 16px Inter')`.
Glyphs baked while a font was still loading are baked again once it is ready.

For a different trade-off, make your own atlas and pass it to the texts that should use it:

```ts

const big = new SdfAtlas({ size: 64, radius: 24 }); // sharper corners far in, longer glows
const heading = new SilkText({ text: 'Overview', fontSize: 40, atlas: big });
```

## Where it stops

Corners round off slightly at extreme zoom, because a single-channel distance field cannot hold a
sharp corner. At the default 48 px bake the rounding is about a fiftieth of the font size.

Emoji and colour fonts come out as one-colour silhouettes. There is no shaping: no ligatures, no
right-to-left text and no combining marks, and each code point is one glyph. Latin, Greek and
Cyrillic UI text works. Use PixiJS `Text` for emoji, Arabic and Indic scripts.

SilkText runs on WebGL2 and WebGPU. Pixi's WebGL1 fallback is not supported.

---

# Editing text

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editing-text/
Section: Text

> TextEditor turns a SilkText into a text layer people click and type into: caret, selection, undo, clipboard, forms and input methods, on the canvas.

`TextEditor` from `pixi-silk/ui/textedit` wraps a [SilkText](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/text/) with a caret, a
selection and keyboard input. It is a display object, so it pans and zooms with a
[camera](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/canvas-and-rulers/) like the rest of the scene.

## Make a text layer editable

Live demo `text-edit-canvas` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { linear, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { bindHistoryKeys, History } from 'pixi-silk/history';
import { SilkText, silkLabel } from 'pixi-silk/text';
import { Camera, ZoomControl } from 'pixi-silk/ui/camera';
import { TextEditor } from 'pixi-silk/ui/textedit';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Click a text to edit it, drag to select, double click a word. Pinch or ctrl + scroll to zoom in
// and keep typing: the caret, the selection and the glyphs stay sharp. Scroll pans.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [760, 440],
    background: 0x151517,
    touchAction: 'none',
    ownsCamera: true,
    setup({ silk }) {
        const app = silk.app;
        const world = new Container();
        const camera = new Camera({ world, element: app.canvas });
        const zoom = new ZoomControl(camera, { label: silkLabel() });
        // one undo stack for the whole canvas: text edits sit in it with everything else
        const history = new History();
        const font = 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';

        app.stage.addChild(world, zoom);

        const card = new SilkGraphics()
            .roundRect(0, 0, 420, 260, 28, 0.6)
            .fill(linear([0x2c2c30, 0x1c1c1f], { from: [0, 0], to: [0, 1] }))
            .roundRect(0.5, 0.5, 419, 259, 28, 0.6)
            .stroke({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.08, width: 1 });
        const caption = new SilkText({ text: 'Frame 1', fontFamily: font, fontSize: 11, fill: 0x8e8e93 });

        caption.position.set(2, -18);
        world.addChild(card, caption);

        const title = new TextEditor({
            text: 'Edit me',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 30,
            fontWeight: 700,
            fill: 0xffffff,
            multiline: false,
            history,
            element: app.canvas,
        });
        const body = new TextEditor({
            text: 'Text on an infinite canvas. Zoom to 800% and the caret is still one crisp pixel and a half wide.\n\nDouble click a word, triple click a paragraph.',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 15,
            lineHeight: 22,
            fill: 0xc7c7cc,
            width: 356,
            placeholder: 'Write something',
            history,
            element: app.canvas,
        });

        title.position.set(32, 30);
        body.position.set(32, 86);
        world.addChild(title, body);

        // a tiny caption follows the title as you type
        const count = new SilkText({ fontFamily: font, fontSize: 11, fill: 0x636366, tabularNumbers: true });

        count.position.set(32, 230);
        world.addChild(count);
        const update = () => {
            const words = body.value.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;

            count.text = `${title.value.length} characters in the title, ${words} words below`;
        };
        const stops = [title.state.text.subscribe(update), body.state.text.subscribe(update), bindHistoryKeys(history)];

        update();
        const place = () =>
            zoom.position.set(app.screen.width - zoom.size[0] - 12, app.screen.height - zoom.size[1] - 12);

        app.renderer.on('resize', place);
        place();
        camera.fit({ x: -20, y: -40, width: 460, height: 320 }, 24, false);

        return () => {
            for (const stop of stops) stop();
            app.renderer.off('resize', place);
            title.destroy();
            body.destroy();
            camera.destroy();
        };
    },
});
```

```ts

declare const world: Container;
declare const canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;

const note = new TextEditor({
    text: 'Edit me',
    fontSize: 15,
    width: 320, // wraps at 320, grows in height
    placeholder: 'Write something',
    element: canvas,
});

note.on('change', (text: string) => console.log('saved', text));
world.addChild(note);
```

The note wraps at 320 units and grows downwards as you type. `change` fires when the edit is
committed with a new value. Every SilkText style option works too: font, size, weight, fill,
letter spacing, line height and alignment.

Words for double click and word jumps come from `Intl.Segmenter`, so they follow the language.
Arrow keys move by grapheme, so an emoji or an accented letter is one step.

## How typing reaches the canvas

The keys do not go to the canvas. On focus, the editor puts a hidden `<textarea>` on the page at
the caret and keeps its text and selection in step. The browser types into it, and the editor
applies each change.

That is why the platform's own input works. Input methods for Japanese, Chinese and Korean show
the composed text inline with an underline, and it becomes one undo step when confirmed. Dead
keys, mobile keyboards, autocorrect, the emoji picker and the system clipboard work too.

The hidden field follows the caret as you type, pan or zoom, so input method popups open next to
the text. Pass `element` (usually `app.canvas`) to place it. Without it, the editor uses the
element of the first press.

## Build a form

Live demo `text-edit-form` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { watch } from 'pixi-silk/signal';
import { SilkText } from 'pixi-silk/text';
import { TextEditor } from 'pixi-silk/ui/textedit';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Single-line fields drawn on the canvas. Tab moves to the next field, Enter in the last one sends
// the form. Japanese or Chinese input, dead keys and the emoji picker type into them as usual.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [520, 330],
    background: 0x0f0f11,
    setup({ silk, stage }) {
        const font = 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';
        const fields: TextEditor[] = [];
        const stops: (() => void)[] = [];
        const field = (label: string, y: number, options: ConstructorParameters<typeof TextEditor>[0]) => {
            const row = new Container();
            const name = new SilkText({ text: label, fontFamily: font, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, fill: 0x8e8e93 });
            const box = new SilkGraphics();
            const editor = new TextEditor({
                fontFamily: font,
                fontSize: 15,
                fill: 0xf2f2f7,
                multiline: false,
                width: 276,
                element: silk.app.canvas,
                ...options,
            });

            editor.position.set(12, 31);
            // a press anywhere on the box focuses the field
            box.eventMode = 'static';
            box.cursor = 'text';
            box.on('pointerdown', (e) => {
                (e.nativeEvent as Event).preventDefault();
                editor.focus();
            });
            row.addChild(name, box, editor);
            row.position.set(40, y);
            // the box lights up while its field has focus
            stops.push(
                watch(editor.state.focused, (on) => {
                    box.clear()
                        .roundRect(0, 20, 300, 40, 10, 0.6)
                        .fill(on ? 0x1c1c22 : 0x18181b)
                        .roundRect(0, 20, 300, 40, 10, 0.6)
                        .stroke({ color: on ? 0x0a84ff : 0x3a3a3c, width: on ? 1.5 : 1, alignment: 'inside' });
                }),
            );
            stage.addChild(row);
            fields.push(editor);

            return editor;
        };

        const name = field('Name', 24, { placeholder: 'Ada Lovelace' });
        const email = field('Email', 104, { placeholder: 'ada@example.com' });
        const code = field('Promo code, 8 characters at most', 184, { placeholder: 'SILK2026', maxLength: 8 });
        const result = new SilkText({
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 12,
            fill: 0x30d158,
            wordWrap: true,
            wordWrapWidth: 150,
        });
        const button = new Container();
        const pill = new SilkGraphics().pill(0, 0, 140, 40).fill(0x0a84ff);
        const label = new SilkText({ text: 'Send', fontFamily: font, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 600, anchor: 0.5 });

        label.position.set(70, 20);
        button.addChild(pill, label);
        button.position.set(360, 228);
        button.eventMode = 'static';
        button.cursor = 'pointer';
        result.position.set(360, 52);
        stage.addChild(button, result);
        const send = () => {
            const values = [name.value || 'no name', email.value || 'no email', code.value || 'no code'];

            result.text = `Sent\n${values.join('\n')}`;
            TextEditor.active?.blur();
        };

        button.on('pointertap', send);
        code.on('submit', send);
        // Enter in the first fields moves on, like a sign-up form
        name.on('submit', () => email.focus(true));
        email.on('submit', () => code.focus(true));
        stops.push(TextEditor.chain(fields));

        return () => {
            for (const stop of stops) stop();
            for (const f of fields) f.destroy();
        };
    },
});
```

With `multiline: false` the editor is an input. Enter commits instead of breaking the line, and a
`width` clips the text and scrolls it to keep the caret in view. `TextEditor.chain()` links fields in
Tab order.

```ts

const email = new TextEditor({ multiline: false, width: 260, placeholder: 'ada@example.com' });
const code = new TextEditor({ multiline: false, width: 260, maxLength: 8 });

TextEditor.chain([email, code]);
code.on('submit', () => console.log(email.value, code.value));
```

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `multiline` | true | A text area, or a single-line input |
| `width` | none | Wraps a text area, clips and scrolls an input. Without it the box grows with the text |
| `placeholder` | empty | Shown while the text is empty |
| `maxLength` | none | Longest text in UTF-16 code units, like `maxlength`. Never splits an emoji |
| `readOnly` | false | Selectable and copyable, not editable |
| `selectable` | true | False turns pointer input off |
| `enter` | `newline`, or `commit` for one line | `newline`, `commit` or `blur`. Shift + Enter breaks the line in a text area |
| `tab` | `next` | `next` emits `tab` and leaves, `insert` types a tab |
| `history` | its own | A `HistoryLike` to share the app's undo stack |
| `ariaLabel` | the placeholder | Name of the field for screen readers |
| `handles` | true | Drag handles at the ends of a touch selection |
| `caretWidth` | 1.5 | Caret width in screen pixels, whatever the zoom |
| `theme` | blue | Caret, selection and composition colours |

In a multi-line field, cmd or ctrl + Enter commits and leaves. Escape leaves any field.

## Show text people can copy

Live demo `text-edit-readonly` (source):

```ts
import { SilkText } from 'pixi-silk/text';
import { TextEditor } from 'pixi-silk/ui/textedit';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// A read-only paragraph: select with the mouse or a long press, cmd or ctrl + C copies.
// There is no caret and typing does nothing.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [520, 260],
    background: 0x0b0b0d,
    setup({ silk, stage }) {
        const font = 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';
        const paragraph = new TextEditor({
            text: 'Release notes. Text layers now edit on the canvas. Selection, the clipboard and input methods go through a hidden text field, so they behave the way the platform does. Double click a word to select it.',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 15,
            lineHeight: 23,
            fill: 0xd1d1d6,
            width: 440,
            readOnly: true,
            element: silk.app.canvas,
            theme: { selection: 0xffd60a, selectionAlpha: 0.28 },
        });
        const readout = new SilkText({ fontFamily: font, fontSize: 12, fill: 0x8e8e93 });

        paragraph.position.set(40, 36);
        readout.position.set(40, 214);
        stage.addChild(paragraph, readout);
        const stop = paragraph.state.selection.subscribe(() => {
            const n = paragraph.selectedText.length;

            readout.text = n ? `${n} characters selected. Cmd or ctrl + C copies them.` : '';
        });

        return () => {
            stop();
            paragraph.destroy();
        };
    },
});
```

`readOnly: true` keeps clicking, selecting and copying, and drops the caret and editing. Use it for
release notes, logs or error messages.

## Events, signals and undo

The editor emits `focus`, `blur`, `input` on every edit, `change` on a commit with a new value,
`submit` on Enter in a single-line field, and `tab`. The same state is on `editor.state` as
[signals](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/radial-menus-and-buttons/#state-in-signals): `text`, `committed`, `focused`,
`selection` and `composing`.

Undo is built in. Consecutive typing folds into one step, and a click or an arrow key starts the
next. To keep text edits in the same stack as the rest of an editor, pass its history:

```ts

const history = new History();
const title = new TextEditor({ text: 'Frame 1', multiline: false, history });

bindHistoryKeys(history); // cmd + Z outside the field undoes text edits too
```

## Find a caret from a point

The caret math lives in the text layout, so other tools can use it. `caretAt(point)` returns the
caret nearest a local point. `caretRect(index)` gives where a caret sits and `rangeRects(from, to)`
the highlight boxes of a range. They follow wrapped lines, alignment, letter spacing and trailing
spaces.

```ts

const label = new SilkText({ text: 'Hello world', wordWrap: true, wordWrapWidth: 60 });
const hit = label.caretAt({ x: 30, y: 8 });
const caret = label.caretRect(hit.index, hit.upstream);

console.log(hit.index, caret.x, label.rangeRects(0, 5));
```

`pixi-silk/text` also exports these as functions on a `TextLayout`, with `graphemeStops`,
`wordAt` and the word jumps.

## Where it stops

Right-to-left and mixed-direction text is not supported. Arabic and Hebrew lay out left to right,
and the caret moves in source order. Emoji count as one caret step but draw as one-colour
silhouettes, and there are no ligatures, as in [SilkText](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/text/#where-it-stops).

Spell check underlines do not show, because the hidden field is invisible.

---

# Radial menus and buttons

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/radial-menus-and-buttons/
Section: Interface

> RadialMenu is a marking menu with nested rings and per-device tuning. SilkButton animates in and out and ignores input while it moves or is busy.

A radial menu puts its items in a ring around the pointer, so a press, a drag towards an item and
a release pick it in one gesture. A button here is a widget that knows when it should not take a press.

## Open a radial menu

Live demo `radial-menu` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import type { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { SilkButton } from 'pixi-silk/ui/button';
import { bindRadialTrigger, type RadialItem, RadialMenu } from 'pixi-silk/ui/radial';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Vector icons: drawn once in white around (0, 0); the menu tints them.
type Icon = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => void;
const pointer: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.triangle(-s * 0.3, -s * 0.42, s * 0.34, s * 0.06, -s * 0.06, s * 0.16, 2).fill(0xffffff);
    g.line(-s * 0.02, s * 0.12, s * 0.16, s * 0.42).stroke({ width: s * 0.12, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
};
const move: Icon = (g, s) => {
    const r = s * 0.42;

    g.line(-r, 0, r, 0).stroke({ width: s * 0.09, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
    g.line(0, -r, 0, r).stroke({ width: s * 0.09, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const a = (i * Math.PI) / 2;

        g.regularPoly(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, s * 0.14, 3, a + Math.PI / 2, 1).fill(0xffffff);
    }
};
const rotate: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.arcSweep(0, 0, s * 0.32, -Math.PI * 0.35, Math.PI * 1.6).stroke({
        width: s * 0.1,
        cap: 'round',
        color: 0xffffff,
    });
    g.regularPoly(s * 0.18, -s * 0.3, s * 0.14, 3, Math.PI / 2, 1).fill(0xffffff);
};
const scale: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.roundRect(-s * 0.4, -s * 0.1, s * 0.5, s * 0.5, 3).stroke({ width: s * 0.08, color: 0xffffff });
    g.roundRect(-s * 0.1, -s * 0.42, s * 0.52, s * 0.52, 3).fill(0xffffff);
};
const gear: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.circle(0, 0, s * 0.33).stroke({ width: s * 0.16, dash: [s * 0.13, s * 0.13], color: 0xffffff });
    g.circle(0, 0, s * 0.22).stroke({ width: s * 0.1, color: 0xffffff });
};
const more: Icon = (g, s) => {
    for (const x of [-1, 0, 1]) g.circle(x * s * 0.28, 0, s * 0.09).fill(0xffffff);
};
const heart: Icon = (g, s) => g.heart(0, 0, s * 0.8, 0.1).fill(0xffffff);
const star: Icon = (g, s) => g.star(0, 0, 5, s * 0.45, undefined, 0, 1.5).fill(0xffffff);
const plus: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.line(-s * 0.35, 0, s * 0.35, 0).stroke({ width: s * 0.13, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
    g.line(0, -s * 0.35, 0, s * 0.35).stroke({ width: s * 0.13, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
};

const tools: RadialItem[] = [
    { id: 'select', label: 'SELECT', icon: pointer },
    {
        id: 'move',
        label: 'MOVE',
        icon: move,
        children: [
            { id: 'intuitive', label: 'Intuitive' },
            { id: 'axis', label: 'Axis' },
            { id: 'free', label: 'Free' },
        ],
    },
    {
        id: 'rotate',
        label: 'ROTATE',
        icon: rotate,
        children: [
            { id: 'uniform', label: 'Uniform' },
            { id: 'axis', label: 'Axis' },
            { id: 'free', label: 'Free' },
        ],
    },
    { id: 'scale', label: 'SCALE', icon: scale },
    { id: 'settings', label: 'SETTINGS', icon: gear, disabled: true },
    { id: 'more', label: 'MORE', icon: more },
];

// Press anywhere (or the round button) and drag to an item, or tap to keep the menu open.
// The `+` button opens a half ring that turns away from the edge it sits on.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 400],
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        closeOnLeave: { type: 'toggle', label: 'close on leave', value: false },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const surface = new Container();
        const status = new Text({
            text: 'press, drag, release, or tap',
            style: { fill: 0x8e8e93, fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 13 },
        });
        const bounds = { x: 0, y: 0, width: 640, height: 400 };
        const report = (_item: RadialItem, path: readonly RadialItem[]) => {
            status.text = `picked  ${path.map((i) => i.id).join(' › ')}`;
        };
        const menu = new RadialMenu({ items: tools, bounds, ticker, onSelect: report });
        const quick = new RadialMenu({
            items: [
                { id: 'heart', label: 'LIKE', icon: heart },
                { id: 'star', label: 'FAVOURITE', icon: star },
                { id: 'plus', label: 'ADD', icon: plus },
                { id: 'more', label: 'MORE', icon: more },
            ],
            sweep: Math.PI * 0.9,
            innerRadius: 34,
            outerRadius: 92,
            bounds,
            ticker,
            onSelect: report,
        });
        const hub = new SilkButton({ shape: 'circle', height: 64, icon: gear, iconSize: 28, ticker });
        const add = new SilkButton({ shape: 'circle', height: 52, icon: plus, iconSize: 22, ticker });

        surface.eventMode = 'static';
        surface.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x <= 640 && y <= 400 };
        status.position.set(20, 18);
        hub.position.set(200, 210);
        add.position.set(586, 346);
        stage.addChild(surface, status, hub, add, menu, quick);

        bindRadialTrigger(surface, menu, { at: 'pointer' });
        bindRadialTrigger(hub, menu);
        bindRadialTrigger(add, quick);
        menu.state.hover.subscribe((item) => {
            if (item) status.text = `${menu.state.kind.value}: ${item.id}${item.disabled ? ' (disabled)' : ''}`;
        });

        tick(() => {
            menu.closeOnLeave = quick.closeOnLeave = params.closeOnLeave;
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

```ts

const menu = new RadialMenu({
    items: [
        { id: 'select', label: 'SELECT', icon: drawPointer },
        { id: 'move', label: 'MOVE', icon: drawMove, children: [{ id: 'axis', label: 'Axis' }, { id: 'free', label: 'Free' }] },
        { id: 'delete', label: 'DELETE', icon: drawTrash, disabled: true },
    ],
    sweep: Math.PI * 2, // Math.PI for a half ring
    bounds: { x: 0, y: 0, width: app.screen.width, height: app.screen.height },
    onSelect: (item, path) => console.log(path.map((i) => i.id).join(' > ')),
});

app.stage.addChild(menu);
bindRadialTrigger(toolButton, menu); // or menu.openAt(x, y, event)
```

A press on `toolButton` opens the menu at the pointer. `onSelect` gets the item and the path to it
through the rings, so a pick in the second ring logs `move > axis`.

The menu picks by angle. Past a small dead zone the whole wedge counts, out to the falloff
distance, so a fast flick lands on its item even when the pointer overshoots the ring. The current
item holds until the pointer is clearly past its edge, so a shaky finger on a boundary does not
flicker between two items.

Items with `children` open the next ring around themselves, to any depth. A full ring slides to
stay inside `bounds`, and a partial ring turns to face the inside instead.

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `innerRadius`, `outerRadius` | 40, 100 | The first ring |
| `sweep` | full turn | Angle of the first ring, `Math.PI` for a half |
| `direction` | up | Where the ring faces, in radians |
| `closeOnLeave` | false | Close once the pointer stays outside the falloff area. By default the menu stays |
| `closeOnSelect` | true | Close after a pick |
| `selectParents` | false | Items with children can be picked too |
| `profiles` | per pointer kind | Dead zone, falloff, scale, tap time and hysteresis for mouse, pen and touch |
| `hub` | true | Draw the centre disc |

Touch gets bigger targets and more forgiveness than a mouse. Override any of it with `profiles`.

Icons are a string, a texture, a container or a function that draws with SilkGraphics in white.
The menu tints them, so a hover colour costs no redraw.

## Make a button that waits

```ts

const play = new SilkButton({
    shape: 'circle',
    height: 76,
    icon: drawPlay,
    holdMs: 450,
    onPress: () => console.log('play'),
    onHold: () => console.log('play on repeat'),
});
const share = new SilkButton({ label: 'Share' });

await share.hide();        // resolves when the animation ends
play.state.busy.set(true); // spinner, input off
play.state.active.subscribe((on) => console.log('accepts input', on));
```

A button accepts input only when it is shown, settled, enabled and not busy. That is what keeps a
save button from being pressed twice while it saves. `show()` and `hide()` return promises that resolve `false`
if the animation was reversed half way. A press that slides a little off the button still counts
on release, within `hitPadding` (6 by default).

`ButtonDock` from `pixi-silk/ui/dock` lines buttons up and closes the gap when one hides. Each
button's space follows its animated appearance, so the reflow and the fade move together.

## State in signals

Every widget keeps its state in `state`: small signals you can read, write and subscribe to.
`pixi-silk/signal` has no Pixi code in it. A signal is a value with `subscribe`, with no
dependency tracking, so it plugs into React, MobX or plain callbacks.

```ts

const volume = signal(1);
const label = computed([volume], () => `volume ${volume.value}`);

volume.subscribe((now, before) => console.log(before, '->', now));
batch(() => {
    volume.set(2);
    volume.set(3);
}); // one notification
```

`computed` takes its sources as a list, so it recomputes only when one of them changes. Widgets
animate on `Ticker.shared` and leave the ticker once nothing moves. Pass `ticker` to use your
application's ticker, or `null` to step them yourself with `tick(dt)`.

---

# Layout and smart containers

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/layout/
Section: Interface

> Place blocks on portrait and landscape screens with SmartContainer records and breakpoints, then lay out what is inside them with flexbox. pixi-silk/ui/layout.

`SmartContainer` places a whole block on the screen, such as a corner readout, the main view or a
bottom bar, on portrait and landscape screens. `FlexContainer` arranges children inside a block with flexbox. Both come from
`pixi-silk/ui/layout`.

## Place blocks on portrait and landscape screens

Live demo `layout-hud` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { SilkText } from 'pixi-silk/text';
import {
    DEVICES,
    FlexContainer,
    layoutDebug,
    SmartContainer,
    type SmartContainerOptions,
    simulateViewport,
} from 'pixi-silk/ui/layout';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// A slot game HUD built from SmartContainers, each placed by a portrait and a landscape record.
// The balance pins to the top left corner, the menu to the top right, the reels stay centred and
// fit, and the bar stretches along the bottom with a flex row inside. Pick a device: the page
// previews it letterboxed, and the HUD glides to the new breakpoint. Press L, or tick debug, for
// the layout overlay. Hover a box for its readout.

const GOLD = 0xffd60a;
const font = 'system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif';

/** A 5 by 3 reel window with a few vector symbols, 1040x640 design units. */
function reels(): Container {
    const g = new SilkGraphics();

    g.roundRect(0, 0, 1040, 640, 40, 0.6).fill(0x1c1c1e);
    for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
        for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
            const x = 20 + c * 200 + 100;
            const y = 20 + r * 200 + 100;
            const kind = (c * 7 + r * 3) % 5;

            g.roundRect(x - 88, y - 88, 176, 176, 32, 0.6).fill(0x2c2c2e);
            if (kind === 0) g.heart(x, y + 4, 104, 8).fill(0xff375f);
            else if (kind === 1) g.circle(x, y, 52).fill(0x0a84ff);
            else if (kind === 2) g.regularPoly(x, y, 60, 6, 0, 12).fill(0x30d158);
            else if (kind === 3) g.triangle(x, y - 56, x + 56, y + 44, x - 56, y + 44, 12).fill(0xbf5af2);
            else g.regularPoly(x, y, 60, 4, Math.PI / 4, 8).fill(GOLD);
        }
    }

    return g;
}

/** A pill with a label and a value. The value shrinks to fit the pill, never below 0.55. */
function pill(label: string, value: string, color: number): { box: FlexContainer; value: SilkText } {
    const box = new FlexContainer({ layout: { direction: 'column', padding: [14, 28], gap: 2 } });
    const bg = new SilkGraphics();
    const v = new SilkText({ text: value, fontFamily: font, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 52, fill: color });

    box.add(bg, {
        position: 'absolute',
        inset: 0,
        onSize: (w, h) => bg.clear().roundRect(0, 0, w, h, 30, 0.6).fill(0x1c1c1e),
    });
    box.add(new SilkText({ text: label, fontFamily: font, fontSize: 24, fill: 0x8e8e93 }));
    box.add(v, { fit: 'scale-down', minScale: 0.55 });

    return { box, value: v };
}

/** A round button with a label on it. */
function button(radius: number, color: number, text: string): Container {
    const c = new Container();

    c.addChild(
        new SilkGraphics().circle(0, 0, radius).fill(color),
        new SilkText({ text, fontFamily: font, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: radius * 0.4, fill: 0xffffff, anchor: 0.5 }),
    );
    c.eventMode = 'static';
    c.cursor = 'pointer';

    return c;
}

const money = (n: number) => `$${n.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;

export default defineDemo({
    size: [920, 520],
    background: 0x0b0b0d,
    controls: {
        device: { type: 'select', label: 'device', options: Object.keys(DEVICES), value: 'desktop' },
        notch: { type: 'toggle', label: 'notch', value: false },
        debug: { type: 'toggle', label: 'debug', value: false },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        // a device window previewed inside the page. Every SmartContainer follows it.
        const sim = simulateViewport({ area: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 920, height: 520 }, device: 'desktop' });
        const debug = layoutDebug(silk.app, { key: 'KeyL' });
        const all: SmartContainer[] = [];
        const make = (label: string, options: SmartContainerOptions) => {
            const c = new SmartContainer({
                ticker: silk.app.ticker,
                viewport: sim,
                // games usually snap. The demo glides on the switch to show where things go.
                switchTransition: { stiffness: 160, damping: 22 },
                ...options,
            });

            c.label = label;
            all.push(c);
            sim.content.addChild(c);

            return c;
        };

        // background: covers the whole window, under the notch too
        const bg = make('background', {
            portraitData: { width: 1080, height: 1920, fitCover: true, ignoreSafeArea: true },
            landscapeData: { width: 1920, height: 1080, fitCover: true, ignoreSafeArea: true },
        });

        bg.addChild(new SilkGraphics().rect(0, 0, 1920, 1920).fill(0x101014));

        // reels: centred, fit to the reference resolution, moved up to leave room for the bar
        make('reels', {
            portraitData: { width: 1040, height: 640, correctionOffsetY: -200 },
            landscapeData: { width: 1040, height: 640, correctionOffsetY: -50 },
        }).addChild(reels());

        // balance pinned to the top left corner, menu to the top right
        const corner = make('balance', {
            layout: { padding: 24 },
            portraitData: { align: 'left', valign: 'top', width: 440, height: 170 },
            landscapeData: { align: 'left', valign: 'top', width: 440, height: 170 },
        });

        corner.add(pill('BALANCE', '$12,480.00', 0xffffff).box, { grow: 1 });

        make('menu', {
            layout: { justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' },
            portraitData: { align: 'right', valign: 'top', width: 140, height: 140 },
            landscapeData: { align: 'right', valign: 'top', width: 140, height: 140 },
        }).add(button(40, 0x2c2c2e, 'MENU'));

        // the bar: along the bottom and as wide as the window, with a flex row inside
        const bar = make('bar', {
            layout: {
                padding: [16, 32, 28],
                gap: 24,
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                media: [{ breakpoint: 'portrait', style: { wrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'center', rowGap: 16 } }],
            },
            portraitData: { valign: 'bottom', width: 1080, height: 420, extendWidth: true },
            landscapeData: { valign: 'bottom', width: 1920, height: 200, extendWidth: true },
        });
        const win = pill('WIN', '$0.00', GOLD);
        const bet = pill('BET', '$2.00', 0xffffff);
        const spin = button(76, 0x30d158, 'SPIN');

        // in portrait the spin button takes a row of its own above the two pills
        bar.add(spin, { media: [{ breakpoint: 'portrait', style: { basis: '100%' } }] });
        bar.add(bet.box, { grow: 1, basis: 0, maxWidth: 440 });
        bar.add(win.box, { grow: 1, basis: 0, maxWidth: 440 });

        spin.on('pointertap', () => {
            win.value.text = money(Math.random() < 0.3 ? 0 : 10 ** (1 + Math.random() * 5));
            // new text, new size: measure it again
            win.box.invalidate(win.value);
        });

        stage.addChild(sim);

        let last = '';
        let debugParam = false;

        tick(() => {
            // the checkbox and the L key both toggle the overlay
            if (params.debug !== debugParam) {
                debugParam = params.debug;
                if (debug.enabled !== debugParam) debug.toggle();
            }
            const key = `${params.device}|${params.notch}`;

            if (key === last) return;
            last = key;
            const [w, h] = DEVICES[params.device];

            for (const c of all)
                c.setSafeArea(params.notch ? (w > h ? { left: 44, right: 44 } : { top: 47, bottom: 34 }) : {});
            sim.setDevice(params.device);
        });

        return () => {
            debug.destroy();
            for (const c of all) c.destroy({ children: true });
        };
    },
});
```

The screen above is five SmartContainers. One readout pins to the top left and the menu to the top
right. The main view stays centred, the bar runs along the bottom and the background covers the
whole window.

```ts

const main = new SmartContainer({
    viewport: app,
    portraitData: { width: 1040, height: 640, correctionOffsetY: -200 },
    landscapeData: { width: 1040, height: 640, correctionOffsetY: -50 },
});

app.stage.addChild(main);
```
