# Showcase

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/showcase/
Section: Examples

> Five design sheets rebuilt pixel for pixel, three dashboard scenes and four light scenes, all drawn with pixi-silk. Open any of them in Studio.

Whole screens built with pixi-silk. They are site code, not library code, so copy the parts you
need. Each demo opens in Studio with its source.

## Design sheets, rebuilt 1:1

Each pair shows the reference image and a still frame of the live render. Open a sheet to drag a
compare slider over it. The widget viewer and the experiments listed at the end of this page open
any single widget full screen.

The five sheets open full screen from the experiments listed with this page.

## Dashboards

Live demo `weather-mono` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text, type TextStyleFontWeight } from 'pixi.js';
import { damp, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// A monochrome weather dashboard. Static shapes redraw only while the theme fades, the needle,
// compass and sunrise arrow move on their own layer every frame.

const W = 390;
const H = 900;
const MONO = '"JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace';

interface Palette {
    bg: number;
    card: number;
    disc: number;
    onDisc: number;
    ink: number;
    faint: number;
}

const LIGHT: Palette = {
    bg: 0xdcdedb,
    card: 0xebecea,
    disc: 0x1d1d1d,
    onDisc: 0xf2f2f2,
    ink: 0x1d1d1d,
    faint: 0x9a9c99,
};
const DARK: Palette = {
    bg: 0x000000,
    card: 0x1e1f21,
    disc: 0xe9eaea,
    onDisc: 0x111111,
    ink: 0xf2f2f2,
    faint: 0x6a6b6d,
};

const mix = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => {
    const ch = (s: number) => Math.round(((a >> s) & 255) + (((b >> s) & 255) - ((a >> s) & 255)) * t) << s;

    return ch(16) | ch(8) | ch(0);
};
const blend = (t: number): Palette => ({
    bg: mix(LIGHT.bg, DARK.bg, t),
    card: mix(LIGHT.card, DARK.card, t),
    disc: mix(LIGHT.disc, DARK.disc, t),
    onDisc: mix(LIGHT.onDisc, DARK.onDisc, t),
    ink: mix(LIGHT.ink, DARK.ink, t),
    faint: mix(LIGHT.faint, DARK.faint, t),
});

// layout: two columns of cards under the hero row
const COL = [20, 205];
const CARD_W = 165;
const CARD_H = 165;
const ROW = [330, 515, 700];
const hair = (color: number, alpha = 1) => ({ width: 1.25, color, alpha });

type Role = 'ink' | 'onDisc' | 'faint';

export default defineDemo({
    size: [W, H],
    controls: {
        theme: { type: 'select', label: 'theme', options: ['light', 'dark'], value: 'dark' },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const base = new SilkGraphics();
        const live = new SilkGraphics();
        const texts = new Container();
        const labels: [Text, Role][] = [];
        let fade = params.theme === 'dark' ? 1 : 0;
        let drawnFade = -1;

        stage.addChild(base, live, texts);

        const text = (
            value: string,
            x: number,
            y: number,
            size: number,
            role: Role,
            anchor = 0,
            weight: TextStyleFontWeight = '400',
        ) => {
            const t = new Text({
                text: value,
                style: {
                    fill: 0xffffff,
                    fontFamily: MONO,
                    fontSize: size,
                    fontWeight: weight,
                    letterSpacing: size * 0.08,
                },
            });

            t.anchor.set(anchor, 0.5);
            t.position.set(x, y);
            texts.addChild(t);
            labels.push([t, role]);
        };

        // header
        text('BROADGATE', W / 2, 92, 17, 'ink', 0.5);
        // hero
        text('12°', 115, 204, 66, 'onDisc', 0.5, '300');
        text('H:14° L:9°', 115, 254, 13, 'onDisc', 0.5);
        text('AIR QUALITY  21', 228, 162, 13, 'ink');
        text('Fair', 228, 184, 13, 'ink');
        text('UV INDEX 02', 228, 254, 13, 'ink');
        text('Low', 228, 276, 13, 'ink');
        // card titles and values
        const card = (col: number, row: number, title: string, sub: string, value: string, unit = '') => {
            const x = COL[col] + 16;
            const y = ROW[row];

            text(title, x, y + 22, 11, 'ink');
            if (sub) text(sub, x, y + 38, 11, 'ink', 0, '700');
            text(value, x, y + CARD_H - 26, 26, 'ink', 0, '300');
            if (unit) text(unit, x + value.length * 17 + 4, y + CARD_H - 22, 10, 'ink');
        };

        card(0, 0, 'AIR QUALITY', 'Fair', '21');
        card(1, 0, 'HUMIDITY', '', '79%');
        card(0, 1, 'WIND SPEED', '', '7', 'MPH');
        card(1, 1, 'UV INDEX', 'Low', '02');
        card(0, 2, 'SUNRISE', '', '06:11');
        text('N', COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[1] + 56, 9, 'ink', 0.5, '700');
        text('FEELS LIKE', COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[2] + 60, 12, 'onDisc', 0.5);
        text('11°', COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[2] + 100, 46, 'onDisc', 0.5, '300');

        const drawBase = (p: Palette) => {
            const g = base.clear();

            g.rect(0, 0, W, H).fill(p.bg);
            menuIcon(g, 28, 92, p.ink);
            gearIcon(g, W - 38, 92, p);
            g.circle(115, 218, 90).fill(p.disc);
            g.pill(212, 130, 160, 74).fill(p.card);
            g.pill(212, 222, 160, 74).fill(p.card);
            g.line(20, 318, W - 20, 318).stroke(hair(p.ink));
            for (const [col, row] of [
                [0, 0],
                [1, 0],
                [0, 1],
                [1, 1],
                [0, 2],
            ]) {
                g.roundRect(COL[col], ROW[row], CARD_W, CARD_H, 14).fill(p.card);
            }
            gaugeFace(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[0] + 108, p);
            g.circle(COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[0] + 82, 46).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.6));
            g.circle(COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[0] + 82, 37).fill(p.disc);
            compassFace(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[1] + 92, p);
            uvStack(g, COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[1] + 120, p);
            sunriseFace(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[2] + 92, p);
            g.circle(COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[2] + CARD_H / 2, 82).fill(p.disc);
        };

        tick((t, dt) => {
            fade = damp(fade, params.theme === 'dark' ? 1 : 0, 6, dt);
            const p = blend(fade);

            if (Math.abs(fade - drawnFade) > 0.001) {
                drawBase(p);
                drawnFade = fade;
                for (const [label, role] of labels) label.tint = p[role];
            }
            const g = live.clear();

            gaugeNeedle(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[0] + 108, 0.28 + Math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.04, p.ink);
            compassNeedle(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[1] + 92, 0.45 + Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.08, p.onDisc);
            sunriseArrow(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[2] + 92, Math.sin(t * 1.6) * 2.5, p.ink);
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});

function menuIcon(g: SilkGraphics, x: number, y: number, color: number) {
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
        g.circle(x, y + i * 7, 1.5).fill(color);
        g.line(x + 6, y + i * 7, x + 24, y + i * 7).stroke({ width: 1.5, color, cap: 'round' });
    }
}

function gearIcon(g: SilkGraphics, x: number, y: number, p: Palette) {
    g.star(x, y, 8, 13, 10.5, 0, 1.2).fill(p.ink);
    g.circle(x, y, 8.5).fill(p.bg);
    g.circle(x, y, 4).fill(p.ink);
    g.circle(x, y, 2.6).fill(p.bg);
}

function gaugeFace(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, p: Palette) {
    const r = 50;

    g.line(cx - 72, cy, cx + 72, cy).stroke(hair(p.ink));
    g.arc(cx, cy, r, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2).stroke(hair(p.ink));
    for (let i = 0; i <= 16; i++) {
        const a = Math.PI + (i / 16) * Math.PI;
        const inner = i % 4 === 0 ? r - 9 : r - 5;

        g.line(cx + Math.cos(a) * inner, cy + Math.sin(a) * inner, cx + Math.cos(a) * r, cy + Math.sin(a) * r).stroke(
            hair(p.ink),
        );
    }
}

function gaugeNeedle(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, value: number, color: number) {
    const a = Math.PI + value * Math.PI;
    const tipX = cx + Math.cos(a) * 44;
    const tipY = cy + Math.sin(a) * 44;
    const head = 7;

    g.line(cx, cy, tipX, tipY).stroke({ width: 1.5, color, cap: 'round' });
    for (const side of [-0.45, 0.45]) {
        g.line(tipX, tipY, tipX - Math.cos(a + side) * head, tipY - Math.sin(a + side) * head).stroke({
            width: 1.5,
            color,
            cap: 'round',
        });
    }
}

function compassFace(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, p: Palette) {
    g.circle(cx, cy, 44).stroke(hair(p.ink));
    g.circle(cx, cy, 30).fill(p.disc);
    g.regularPoly(cx, cy - 47, 3.5, 3, 0, 0.5).fill(p.ink);
}

function compassNeedle(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, angle: number, color: number) {
    const dx = Math.sin(angle) * 24;
    const dy = -Math.cos(angle) * 24;

    g.line(cx + dx, cy + dy, cx - dx, cy - dy).stroke({ width: 1.4, color, cap: 'round' });
    const back = Math.atan2(-dy, -dx);

    for (const side of [-0.5, 0.5]) {
        g.line(cx - dx, cy - dy, cx - dx - Math.cos(back + side) * 6, cy - dy - Math.sin(back + side) * 6).stroke({
            width: 1.4,
            color,
            cap: 'round',
        });
    }
}

function uvStack(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, p: Palette) {
    // `cy` is the shared base line: each ellipse sits on it, the tallest faintest
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const ry = 36 - i * 6.5;

        g.ellipse(cx, cy - ry, 46, ry).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.22 + i * 0.13));
    }
    g.ellipse(cx, cy, 46, 4.5).stroke({ width: 1.8, color: p.ink });
}

function sunriseFace(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, p: Palette) {
    g.line(cx - 72, cy, cx + 72, cy).stroke(hair(p.ink));
    g.arc(cx, cy, 52, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.45));
    g.arc(cx, cy, 40, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2).stroke({ width: 1.6, color: p.ink });
    g.line(cx - 52, cy + 10, cx + 52, cy + 10).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.7));
    g.line(cx - 34, cy + 18, cx + 34, cy + 18).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.7));
    g.line(cx - 12, cy + 26, cx + 12, cy + 26).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.7));
}

function sunriseArrow(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, lift: number, color: number) {
    const top = cy - 26 - lift;

    g.line(cx, cy - 8, cx, top).stroke({ width: 1.4, color, cap: 'round' });
    g.line(cx, top, cx - 5, top + 6).stroke({ width: 1.4, color, cap: 'round' });
    g.line(cx, top, cx + 5, top + 6).stroke({ width: 1.4, color, cap: 'round' });
}
```

A weather board in two tones. It uses hairlines, discs and one monospace face. The needle, the
compass and the sunrise arrow move on their own layer, so the rest is drawn once.

Live demo `finance-bento` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text, type TextStyleFontWeight, type TextStyleOptions } from 'pixi.js';
import { damp, ease, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { Odometer } from 'pixi-silk/ui/odometer';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// A finance bento board. Every tile is its own container: it slides in on load, lifts on hover,
// and animates its numbers and bars once it has landed.

const W = 720;
const H = 900;
const GAP = 19;
const COL_W = (W - GAP * 4) / 3;
const col = (i: number) => GAP + i * (COL_W + GAP);
const SANS = 'Inter, "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif';

const C = {
    page: 0x2a2a2a,
    orange: 0xf28a2e,
    orangeDeep: 0xd9762a,
    ink: 0x111111,
    stone: 0x8f8f8b,
    mist: 0xd9d9d6,
    paper: 0xf2f2f0,
    olive: 0x7f8b6c,
    oliveDeep: 0x5e6950,
    slate: 0x5a5a5a,
    arrow: 0xc4c4c4,
    clay: 0x7d5546,
    taupe: 0x857a5c,
    sand: 0xc8b88d,
    donut: 0x4a4a4a,
};

interface Tile {
    view: Container;
    /** 0..1 entrance progress, starts after `delay`. */
    enter: number;
    delay: number;
    lift: number;
    hover: boolean;
    /** Redraws the animated parts with the eased entrance value. */
    update?: (p: number, t: number) => void;
}

const label = (
    text: string,
    size: number,
    color: number,
    weight: TextStyleFontWeight = '500',
    extra: TextStyleOptions = {},
) => new Text({ text, style: { fill: color, fontFamily: SANS, fontSize: size, fontWeight: weight, ...extra } });

function tile(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, fill: number, delay: number, radius = 10): Tile {
    const view = new Container();
    const bg = new SilkGraphics();

    bg.roundRect(0, 0, w, h, radius).fill(fill);
    view.addChild(bg);
    view.position.set(x, y);
    view.eventMode = 'static';
    view.hitArea = { contains: (px, py) => px >= 0 && py >= 0 && px <= w && py <= h };

    const t: Tile = { view, enter: 0, delay, lift: 0, hover: false };

    view.on('pointerover', () => (t.hover = true));
    view.on('pointerout', () => (t.hover = false));

    return t;
}

function place(child: Container, x: number, y: number, ax = 0, ay = 0) {
    if ('anchor' in child) (child as Text).anchor.set(ax, ay);
    child.position.set(x, y);

    return child;
}

export default defineDemo({
    size: [W, H],
    setup({ silk, stage, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const tiles: Tile[] = [];
        const bg = new SilkGraphics().rect(0, 0, W, H).fill(C.page);
        const add = (t: Tile) => {
            tiles.push(t);
            stage.addChild(t.view);

            return t;
        };

        stage.addChild(bg);

        // the 78% card: orange, with a progress bar
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(0), 20, COL_W, 240, C.orange, 0));
            const value = new Odometer({
                ticker,
                prefix: '\u2248', // almost equal
                suffix: '%',
                fontSize: 52,
                color: C.ink,
                textStyle: { fontFamily: SANS },
            });
            const bar = new SilkGraphics();

            t.view.addChild(
                value,
                place(label('●  Winning\nInvestors', 22, C.ink, '700', { lineHeight: 24 }), 14, 100),
                place(label('2024 May', 22, 0xb5611d, '700'), 14, 150),
                bar,
            );
            value.position.set(COL_W - 14, 52);
            t.update = (p) => {
                if (p > 0.2 && value.state.value.value === 0) value.set(78);
                value.x = COL_W - 14 - value.width / 2;
                bar.clear()
                    .roundRect(10, 186, COL_W - 20, 44, 4)
                    .fill(C.orangeDeep);
                bar.roundRect(10, 186, (COL_W - 20) * 0.7 * p, 44, 4).fill(C.ink);
            };
        }

        // up arrow tile
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(0), 280, COL_W, 250, C.slate, 0.08));
            const g = new SilkGraphics();
            const cx = COL_W / 2;

            g.rect(cx - 9, 70, 18, 140).fill(C.arrow);
            g.beginPath()
                .moveTo(cx, 60)
                .bezierCurveTo(cx - 8, 90, cx - 40, 110, cx - 72, 110)
                .stroke({ width: 18, color: C.arrow });
            g.beginPath()
                .moveTo(cx, 60)
                .bezierCurveTo(cx + 8, 90, cx + 40, 110, cx + 72, 110)
                .stroke({ width: 18, color: C.arrow });
            t.view.addChild(g);
            t.update = (p, time) => {
                g.y = (1 - p) * 30 + Math.sin(time * 1.4) * 3 * p;
            };
        }

        // 24h trading volume
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(0), 550, COL_W, 330, C.clay, 0.16));
            const rows: [boolean, string, string][] = [
                [true, 'Bitcoin', '$67,258.69'],
                [false, 'Ethereum', '$2,631.39'],
                [true, 'Tether', '$0.9992'],
                [false, 'Solana', '$167.92'],
                [true, 'Cardano', '$0.362'],
                [false, 'Toncoin', '$5.25'],
            ];
            const lines = new SilkGraphics();

            t.view.addChild(place(label('24h Trading\nVolume', 22, C.ink, '700', { lineHeight: 24 }), 16, 20), lines);
            rows.forEach(([up, name, price], i) => {
                const y = 330 - (rows.length - i) * 37 + 12;

                lines.rect(0, y - 18, COL_W, 1).fill({ color: C.ink, alpha: 0.25 });
                t.view.addChild(
                    place(label(up ? '▲' : '▼', 10, C.ink), 16, y, 0, 0.5),
                    place(label(name, 13, C.ink, '600'), 34, y, 0, 0.5),
                    place(label(price, 13, C.ink, '600'), COL_W - 14, y, 1, 0.5),
                );
            });
        }

        // send / receive
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(1), 20, COL_W, 170, C.stone, 0.04));
            const inner = new SilkGraphics();
            const send = new Odometer({
                ticker,
                fontSize: 38,
                color: C.ink,
                textStyle: { fontFamily: SANS, fontWeight: '400' },
            });

            inner.roundRect(8, 8, COL_W - 16, 72, 7).fill(0xadada9);
            inner.roundRect(8, 88, COL_W - 16, 74, 7).fill(C.mist);
            t.view.addChild(
                inner,
                place(label('Send', 16, 0x3b3b3b, '400'), 22, 30, 0, 0.5),
                place(label('USD', 11, 0x555555, '400'), 22, 64, 0, 0.5),
                send,
                place(label('Receive', 16, 0x3b3b3b, '400'), 22, 110, 0, 0.5),
                place(label('BTC', 11, 0x555555, '400'), 22, 146, 0, 0.5),
                place(label('0,0018', 38, C.ink, '400'), COL_W - 22, 136, 1, 0.5),
            );
            send.y = 54;
            t.update = (p) => {
                if (p > 0.2 && send.state.value.value === 0) send.set(134);
                send.x = COL_W - 22 - send.width / 2;
            };
        }

        // research card: a price, then three plan cards stacked on its lower half
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(1), 205, COL_W, 470, 0xbdbdba, 0.12));
            const g = new SilkGraphics();
            const plans: [string, string, number, number][] = [
                ['Key\nBenefits', 'AI tools', 2, 0xdcdcda],
                ['Pricing\nPlans', 'Premium', 15, C.paper],
                ['Trusted\nInvestors', 'Trust', 54, C.taupe],
            ];
            const top = [214, 278, 342];
            const bottom = 462;
            const counters: Odometer[] = [];
            const trust = new SilkGraphics();
            const price = label('$23,485', 32, C.ink, '400');
            const cents = label('.95', 32, 0x8c8c8a, '400');

            t.view.addChild(
                g,
                place(label('Best Crypto\nResearch', 22, C.ink, '700', { lineHeight: 24 }), 16, 16),
                place(price, 16, 186, 0, 0.5),
                place(cents, 16 + price.width, 186, 0, 0.5),
            );
            plans.forEach(([name, sub, , fill], i) => {
                const y = top[i];

                g.roundRect(6, y, COL_W - 12, bottom - y, 8).fill(fill);
                const counter = new Odometer({
                    ticker,
                    fontSize: 40,
                    color: C.ink,
                    textStyle: { fontFamily: SANS, fontWeight: '400' },
                });

                counter.y = y + 38;
                counters.push(counter);
                t.view.addChild(
                    place(label(name, 11, C.ink, '700', { lineHeight: 12 }), 16, y + 10),
                    place(label(sub, 9, 0x5d5d5b, '400'), 16, y + 52, 0, 0.5),
                    counter,
                );
            });
            t.view.addChild(
                place(label('%', 18, 0x3b3b3b, '400'), COL_W - 80, top[2] + 44, 1, 0.5),
                place(label('Do not trust', 9, 0x4a4535, '400'), COL_W - 16, top[2] + 74, 1, 0.5),
                trust,
            );
            t.update = (p) => {
                counters.forEach((c, i) => {
                    if (p > 0.3 && c.state.value.value === 0) c.set(plans[i][2]);
                    c.x = COL_W - 18 - c.width / 2;
                });
                const barY = top[2] + 84;

                trust
                    .clear()
                    .roundRect(10, barY + 8, COL_W - 20, bottom - barY - 12, 6)
                    .fill(0x6c6450);
                trust.roundRect(10, barY, (COL_W - 20) * 0.54 * p, bottom - barY - 4, 6).fill(C.sand);
            };
        }

        // currency tiles
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(1), 690, COL_W, 190, 0xbdbdba, 0.2));
            const g = new SilkGraphics();
            const half = (COL_W - 24) / 2;

            t.view.addChild(g);
            ['₿', '$', '€', '¥'].forEach((sign, i) => {
                const x = 8 + (i % 2) * (half + 8);
                const y = 8 + Math.floor(i / 2) * 91;

                g.roundRect(x, y, half, 83, 7).fill(C.paper);
                t.view.addChild(place(label(sign, 38, C.ink, '400'), x + half / 2, y + 42, 0.5, 0.5));
            });
        }

        // weekly bars
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(2), 20, COL_W, 375, C.olive, 0.08));
            const bars = new SilkGraphics();
            const days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
            const totals = [0.86, 0.75, 0.6, 0.68, 0.84, 0.67, 0.78];
            const filled = [0.3, 0.55, 0.18, 0.37, 0.75, 0.42, 0.28];
            const total = new Odometer({
                ticker,
                decimals: 2,
                prefix: '$',
                fontSize: 22,
                color: C.ink,
                textStyle: { fontFamily: SANS, fontWeight: '400' },
            });
            const slot = (COL_W - 24) / 7;

            t.view.addChild(
                place(label('You Shop\nData Insights', 20, C.ink, '700', { lineHeight: 22 }), 14, 14),
                bars,
                place(label('All Time:', 12, 0x2f3527, '400'), 14, 350, 0, 0.5),
                total,
            );
            days.forEach((d, i) =>
                t.view.addChild(place(label(d, 10, 0x3a4130, '400'), 12 + slot * (i + 0.5), 316, 0.5, 0.5)),
            );
            total.y = 350;
            t.update = (p) => {
                if (p > 0.4 && total.state.value.value === 0) total.set(637.55);
                total.x = COL_W - 14 - total.width / 2;
                bars.clear();
                totals.forEach((v, i) => {
                    const x = 12 + slot * i + 3;
                    const w = slot - 6;
                    const grow = ease.outCubic(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p * 1.4 - i * 0.06)));
                    const full = 220 * v * grow;
                    const fill = 220 * filled[i] * grow;

                    if (full > 1) bars.roundRect(x, 300 - full, w, full, 6).fill(C.oliveDeep);
                    if (fill > 1) bars.roundRect(x, 300 - fill, w, fill, 6).fill(C.ink);
                });
            };
        }

        // one quarter donut
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(2), 415, COL_W, 200, C.page, 0.16));
            const g = new SilkGraphics();
            const cx = COL_W / 2;

            t.view.addChild(g, place(label('¼', 40, C.paper, '500'), cx, 100, 0.5, 0.5));
            t.update = (p) => {
                g.clear().circle(cx, 100, 100).fill(C.donut);
                g.sector(cx, 100, 100, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + (Math.PI / 2) * p, 0).fill(C.mist);
                g.circle(cx, 100, 46).fill(0x262626);
            };
        }

        // clock dial with rotated numbers
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(2), 630, COL_W, 250, C.page, 0.24));
            const face = new SilkGraphics();
            const numbers = new Container();
            const cx = COL_W / 2;
            const cy = 125;

            face.circle(cx, cy, 122).fill(C.mist);
            face.regularPoly(cx + 20, cy + 40, 8, 3, -Math.PI / 6, 1).fill(C.ink);
            numbers.position.set(cx, cy);
            for (let h = 1; h <= 12; h++) {
                const a = (h / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
                const n = place(label(String(h), 30, C.ink, '400'), Math.sin(a) * 96, -Math.cos(a) * 96, 0.5, 0.5);

                n.rotation = a;
                numbers.addChild(n);
            }
            t.view.addChild(face, numbers);
            t.update = (p, time) => {
                numbers.rotation = (1 - p) * -1.2 + Math.sin(time * 0.3) * 0.04;
            };
        }

        tick((time, dt) => {
            for (const t of tiles) {
                const target = time > t.delay ? 1 : 0;

                t.enter = damp(t.enter, target, 5, dt);
                t.lift = damp(t.lift, t.hover ? 1 : 0, 14, dt);
                const p = ease.outCubic(Math.min(1, t.enter));

                t.view.alpha = p;
                t.view.pivot.y = (1 - p) * -24 + t.lift * 4;
                t.update?.(p, time);
            }
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

Each tile is a small container with its own drawing. Lift any one of them into your app as it is.

Live demo `spectra-hud` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text, type TextStyleFontWeight } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// A sci-fi spectrum readout. The frame, labels and gauges are drawn once, the heatmap cells and the
// orientation square redraw every frame.

const W = 1280;
const H = 720;
const CX = 640;
const CY = 360;
const MONO = '"JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace';
const WHITE = 0xf2f2f2;
const DIM = 0x8a8a8a;
const RED = 0xff2b2b;

// heatmap grid: cells inside a circle around the centre
const CELL = 11;
const RADIUS = 150;
const GRID = Math.ceil((RADIUS * 2) / CELL);

const hair = (alpha = 1) => ({ width: 1, color: WHITE, alpha });

/** Blue to red to white, the palette of the hot spot. */
function hot(v: number): number {
    const stops = [0x1a2cff, 0xff1e1e, 0xffffff];
    const x = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v)) * (stops.length - 1);
    const i = Math.min(stops.length - 2, Math.floor(x));
    const t = x - i;
    const ch = (s: number) => Math.round(((stops[i] >> s) & 255) * (1 - t) + ((stops[i + 1] >> s) & 255) * t) << s;

    return ch(16) | ch(8) | ch(0);
}

const grey = (v: number) => {
    const c = Math.round(30 + v * 170);

    return (c << 16) | (c << 8) | c;
};

export default defineDemo({
    size: [W, H],
    background: 0x050505,
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        const frame = new SilkGraphics();
        const cells = new SilkGraphics();
        const live = new SilkGraphics();
        const texts = new Container();
        let frameCount = 0;

        stage.addChild(cells, frame, live, texts);

        const text = (
            value: string,
            x: number,
            y: number,
            size = 8,
            color = DIM,
            anchor = 0,
            weight: TextStyleFontWeight = '400',
        ) => {
            const t = new Text({
                text: value,
                style: { fill: color, fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: size, fontWeight: weight, letterSpacing: 0.6 },
            });

            t.anchor.set(anchor, 0.5);
            t.position.set(x, y);
            texts.addChild(t);

            return t;
        };

        drawTabs(text);
        drawWarning(frame, text);
        drawTitle(text);
        drawPlot(frame, text);
        drawTimeline(frame, text);
        drawCompassFace(frame, text);
        drawEdges(frame);
        drawControls(frame, text);
        drawFooter(frame, text);

        tick((t) => {
            // the heatmap redraws at half the frame rate: plenty for a slow drift
            if (frameCount++ % 2 === 0) drawCells(cells, t);
            live.clear();
            const a = t * 0.35;

            live.save().translateTransform(1165, 98).rotateTransform(a);
            live.rect(-11, -11, 22, 22).stroke({ width: 1, color: 0xffb020 });
            live.restore();
            live.line(1165, 98, 1165 + Math.cos(a - 1.2) * 46, 98 + Math.sin(a - 1.2) * 46).stroke(hair(0.5));
            const blink = Math.sin(t * 4) > 0 ? 1 : 0.35;

            live.circle(30, 680, 2.5).fill({ color: 0xffb020, alpha: blink });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});

type TextFn = (
    value: string,
    x: number,
    y: number,
    size?: number,
    color?: number,
    anchor?: number,
    weight?: TextStyleFontWeight,
) => Text;

function drawCells(g: SilkGraphics, t: number) {
    g.clear();
    const hotX = 0.22 + Math.sin(t * 0.4) * 0.05;
    const hotY = -0.18 + Math.cos(t * 0.33) * 0.04;

    for (let j = 0; j < GRID; j++) {
        for (let i = 0; i < GRID; i++) {
            const x = CX - RADIUS + i * CELL;
            const y = CY - RADIUS + j * CELL;
            const u = (x + CELL / 2 - CX) / RADIUS;
            const v = (y + CELL / 2 - CY) / RADIUS;

            if (u * u + v * v > 1) continue;
            // a soft grey body, brighter towards its lower right, with a slow ripple
            const body =
                Math.max(0, 1 - Math.hypot((u - 0.05) / 0.9, (v - 0.15) / 0.75)) *
                (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(u * 6 + t * 0.7));
            // the hot spot: a squashed blob that drifts inside the selection box
            const heat =
                Math.max(0, 1 - Math.hypot((u - hotX) / 0.42, (v - hotY) / 0.28)) * 1.25 +
                Math.max(0, 0.6 - Math.hypot(u - 0.2, v + 0.55) * 1.6);

            if (heat > 0.18) g.rect(x, y, CELL - 1, CELL - 1).fill(hot(heat - 0.18));
            else if (body > 0.04) g.rect(x, y, CELL - 1, CELL - 1).fill({ color: grey(body), alpha: 0.85 });
        }
    }
}

function drawTabs(text: TextFn) {
    const tabs = [
        'SPATIAL PREPROCESSING',
        'SPECTRAL PREPROCESSING',
        'UNIVARIATE IMAGING',
        'MULTIVARIATE IMAGING',
        'IMAGE PROCESSING',
    ];
    let x = 30;

    for (const [i, tab] of tabs.entries()) {
        const label = text(tab, x, 22, 7, i === 1 ? WHITE : DIM);

        x += label.width + 26;
    }
}

function drawWarning(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    text('IRP WARNING THRESHOLD  84%', 1205, 22, 7, WHITE, 1);
    g.roundRect(1215, 16, 36, 12, 2).fill(RED);
    text('HIGH', 1233, 22, 6, WHITE, 0.5, '700');
}

function drawTitle(text: TextFn) {
    text('06F', 40, 82, 30, WHITE, 0, '700');
    text('Neptune Spectra  /  Logged', 40, 112, 13, WHITE, 0, '600');
    text('APHELION', 40, 140, 6);
    text('30.33 AU (4.54 BILLION KM)', 40, 150, 7, WHITE);
    text('PERIHELION', 40, 168, 6);
    text('29.81 AU (4.46 BILLION KM)', 40, 178, 7, WHITE);
    text('C Time  19:28:24', 40, 486, 7);
    text('P Time  17:06:47', 40, 498, 7);
}

function drawPlot(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    g.circle(CX, CY, RADIUS + 18).stroke(hair(0.35));
    g.rect(CX - 125, CY - 105, 250, 250).stroke(hair(0.9));
    g.rect(CX - 20, CY - 195, 230, 230).stroke({ width: 1, color: WHITE, alpha: 0.9, dash: [4, 4] });
    g.roundRect(CX + 165, CY - 182, 34, 20, 2).fill(WHITE);
    text('06F', CX + 182, CY - 172, 8, 0x050505, 0.5, '700');
    for (const [i, exp] of ['10⁻⁰²', '10⁻⁰⁴', '10⁻⁰⁶', '10⁻¹⁴'].entries()) {
        text(exp, CX - 150, CY - 92 + i * 75, 9, WHITE, 1);
    }
    for (const [i, tick] of ['0.1', '1.0', '10.0'].entries()) text(tick, CX - 110 + i * 110, CY + 225, 10, WHITE, 0.5);
    text('ENERGY  [keV]', CX, CY + 250, 6, DIM, 0.5);
    const axis = text('FLUX  [1 / C M² S]', CX - 196, CY, 6, DIM, 0.5);

    axis.rotation = -Math.PI / 2;
    g.circle(CX - 6, CY + 2, 1.5).fill(WHITE);
}

function drawTimeline(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    const x0 = 560;
    const y = 74;

    text('TIMELINE', x0 - 14, y, 6, DIM, 1);
    for (let i = 0; i <= 40; i++) g.rect(x0 + i * 4, y - 2, 1, 4).fill({ color: WHITE, alpha: 0.35 });
    g.rect(x0 + 30, y - 6, 6, 12).fill(WHITE);
    for (const [i, m] of ['M1', 'M2', 'M3', 'M4', 'M5', 'M6'].entries()) {
        text(m, x0 + 20 + i * 30, y - 12, 6, i === 1 ? WHITE : DIM, 0.5);
    }
    g.rect(CX - 3, 34, 6, 14).fill(WHITE);
    g.rect(CX - 3, H - 48, 6, 14).fill(WHITE);
}

function drawCompassFace(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    const cx = 1165;
    const cy = 98;

    g.circle(cx, cy, 46).stroke(hair(0.6));
    for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
        const a = (i / 36) * Math.PI * 2;
        const r0 = i % 9 === 0 ? 40 : 43;

        g.line(cx + Math.cos(a) * r0, cy + Math.sin(a) * r0, cx + Math.cos(a) * 46, cy + Math.sin(a) * 46).stroke(
            hair(0.6),
        );
    }
    text('0°', cx, cy - 56, 7, WHITE, 0.5);
    text('90°', cx + 58, cy, 7, WHITE, 0);
    text('180°', cx, cy + 56, 7, WHITE, 0.5);
    text('-90°', cx - 58, cy, 7, WHITE, 1);
    text('ROT  -17°', 1140, 168, 6);
    text('SEQ  1.42', 1140, 180, 6);
}

function drawEdges(g: SilkGraphics) {
    g.line(20, CY, 200, CY).stroke(hair(0.3));
    g.line(W - 200, CY, W - 20, CY).stroke(hair(0.3));
    g.line(CX - RADIUS - 40, CY, CX - RADIUS - 18, CY).stroke(hair(0.6));
    g.line(CX + RADIUS + 18, CY, CX + RADIUS + 40, CY).stroke(hair(0.6));
    for (const x of [24, W - 24]) {
        g.circle(x, CY, 2).fill(WHITE);
        g.line(x, CY - 5, x, CY + 5).stroke(hair(0.8));
    }
    for (const x of [CX - 270, CX + 270]) g.circle(x, CY, 2).fill(WHITE);
}

function drawControls(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    text('R', 1214, 548, 11, WHITE, 0.5, '700');
    for (const [i, flip] of [false, true].entries()) {
        const y = 584 + i * 34;

        g.rect(1200, y - 12, 28, 24).stroke(hair(0.8));
        const s = flip ? -1 : 1;

        g.triangle(1214 - 5 * s, y - 6, 1214 - 5 * s, y + 6, 1214 + 6 * s, y).fill(WHITE);
    }
}

function drawFooter(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    text('SPECTRA / 06F', 46, 452, 7, 0x050505, 0, '700');
    g.rect(34, 444, 80, 16).fill(WHITE);
    text('FLUX  [1 / C M² S]', 42, 680, 6);
    text('ENERGY  [keV]', 42, 694, 6);
    g.rect(27, 691, 6, 6).fill(DIM);
    text('Selection  LDK 06F', 80, 700, 10, WHITE);
    text('Form A', 560, 700, 10, WHITE);
    text('1039 / 3972  E', 620, 700, 10, WHITE);
    text('Show Log', W - 30, 700, 7, WHITE, 1);
}
```

The heatmap is about 700 cells in one `SilkGraphics`. It redraws at half the frame rate.

## Light scenes

These use `pixi-silk/glow` and `pixi-silk/glass`. [Glass and glow](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/glass-and-glow/) explains
the pieces.

Live demo `glass-prism` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { Glass } from 'pixi-silk/glass';
import { fan, ray, spectrum } from 'pixi-silk/glow';
import { trackGesture } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gesture';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const mono = (text: string, size = 10, alpha = 0.7) =>
    new Text({
        text,
        style: { fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace', fontSize: size, fill: 0xffffff },
        alpha,
    });
const COLORS = spectrum(8);

export default defineDemo({
    size: [720, 440],
    background: 0x000000,
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        spread: { type: 'range', label: 'spread', min: 0.2, max: 1.2, step: 0.01, value: 0.62 },
        frost: { type: 'range', label: 'frost', min: 0, max: 40, step: 1, value: 14 },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const beam = new SilkGraphics();
        const rainbow = new SilkGraphics();
        const glass = new Glass({
            width: 230,
            height: 200,
            radius: 30,
            refraction: 18,
            dispersion: 0.6,
            grain: 0.06,
            frost: 0.04,
            light: 1,
        });
        const hit = new SilkGraphics();
        const centre = { x: 360, y: 220 };
        let source = { x: 90, y: 420 };

        beam.blendMode = 'add';
        rainbow.blendMode = 'add';
        glass.position.set(centre.x - 115, centre.y - 100);
        glass.content.addChild(mono('2025 Edition'), Object.assign(mono('Reflect wealth'), { x: 140 }));
        for (const t of glass.content.children) t.position.y = 16;
        glass.content.children[0].x = 18;
        const brand = mono('F1', 54, 0.55);

        brand.position.set(150, 120);
        glass.content.addChild(brand);
        hit.rect(0, 0, 720, 440).fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.001 });
        stage.addChild(hit, beam, rainbow, glass);

        trackGesture(hit, {
            onDown: (p) => (source = { x: p.x, y: p.y }),
            onDrag: (p) => (source = { x: p.x, y: p.y }),
        });

        tick((t) => {
            const dx = centre.x - source.x;
            const dy = centre.y - source.y;
            const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
            const shimmer = 1 + Math.sin(t * 2.1) * 0.04;

            glass.set({ blur: params.frost });
            beam.clear();
            ray(beam, { x0: source.x, y0: source.y, x1: centre.x, y1: centre.y, w0: 2, w1: 26 }).fill({
                color: 0xffffff,
                alpha: 0.35,
                blur: 14,
            });
            ray(beam, { x0: source.x, y0: source.y, x1: centre.x, y1: centre.y, w0: 1, w1: 8 }).fill({
                color: 0xffffff,
                alpha: 0.9,
                blur: 3,
            });
            beam.circle(centre.x, centre.y, 40).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.35, blur: 26 });

            rainbow.clear();
            fan(centre.x, centre.y, angle + 0.08, params.spread * shimmer, 620, COLORS.length, 18).forEach((r, i) => {
                ray(rainbow, r).fill({ color: COLORS[i], alpha: 0.5, blur: 24 });
                ray(rainbow, { ...r, w1: r.w1 * 0.45 }).fill({ color: COLORS[i], alpha: 0.6, blur: 4 });
            });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

Live demo `glow-sunrise` (source):

```ts
import { Text, type TextStyleFontWeight } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { Glass } from 'pixi-silk/glass';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const label = (text: string, size: number, color: number, weight: TextStyleFontWeight = '500') =>
    new Text({
        text,
        style: { fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: size, fill: color, fontWeight: weight },
    });

export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 440],
    background: 0x260600,
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        const orb = new SilkGraphics();
        const core = new SilkGraphics();
        const glass = new Glass({
            width: 300,
            height: 130,
            radius: 26,
            blur: 26,
            refraction: 10,
            frost: 0.1,
            tint: 0x3a0a00,
            tintAmount: 0.12,
        });
        const eyebrow = label('WORK SPACE', 10, 0xffd9b8, '600');
        const title = label('Enable Efficient Teamwork', 20, 0xffffff, '600');
        const body = label('Create a culture of clarity across every project.', 12, 0xffd9b8);

        eyebrow.style.letterSpacing = 1.4;
        eyebrow.position.set(24, 26);
        title.position.set(24, 46);
        body.position.set(24, 86);
        glass.content.addChild(eyebrow, title, body);
        glass.position.set(170, 286);
        stage.addChild(orb, core, glass);

        tick((t) => {
            const breathe = 1 + Math.sin(t * 0.8) * 0.03;
            const drift = Math.sin(t * 0.5) * 10;

            // shape 1: a red disc under layer blur 226
            orb.clear()
                .circle(320 + drift * 0.3, 170, 150 * breathe)
                .fill({ color: 0xe5400f, blur: 90 })
                .circle(320, 190, 110)
                .fill({ color: 0xff5a14, alpha: 0.55, blur: 50 });
            // shape 2: a yellow peanut under layer blur 140, and shape 3: the same with a
            // progressive blur, 100 at the top to 0 at the bottom, so it sits on a crisp horizon
            const peanut = (g: SilkGraphics) =>
                g.ellipse(310 + drift, 196, 92, 50).ellipse(330 + drift * 0.6, 228, 112, 46);

            core.clear();
            peanut(core).fill({ color: 0xffb21f, alpha: 0.7, blur: 60, spread: 10 });
            peanut(core).fill({ color: 0xffe14a, blur: { from: 48, to: 0.5, angle: Math.PI / 2 } });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

A red disc under a large blur, and a yellow shape whose blur fades out towards a crisp horizon.
The fade is a progressive blur, covered in [shadows and effects](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/shadows-and-effects/).

Live demo `glow-beams` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { along, linear, radial, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { bolt } from 'pixi-silk/glow';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const W = 760;
const mono = 'ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace';

/** A beam pinched in the middle: full height `h` at both ends, `waist` at the centre. */
function hourglass(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, w: number, h: number, waist: number): SilkGraphics {
    const x0 = cx - w / 2;
    const x1 = cx + w / 2;
    const t = cy - h / 2;
    const b = cy + h / 2;

    return g
        .beginPath()
        .moveTo(x0, t)
        .bezierCurveTo(x0 + w * 0.22, cy - h * 0.1, cx - w * 0.12, cy - waist / 2, cx, cy - waist / 2)
        .bezierCurveTo(cx + w * 0.12, cy - waist / 2, x1 - w * 0.22, cy - h * 0.1, x1, t)
        .lineTo(x1, b)
        .bezierCurveTo(x1 - w * 0.22, cy + h * 0.1, cx + w * 0.12, cy + waist / 2, cx, cy + waist / 2)
        .bezierCurveTo(cx - w * 0.12, cy + waist / 2, x0 + w * 0.22, cy + h * 0.1, x0, b)
        .closePath();
}

function label(text: string, x: number, y: number, color: number, anchorX = 0): Text {
    const t = new Text({ text, style: { fontFamily: mono, fontSize: 10, fill: color } });

    t.anchor.set(anchorX, 0);
    t.position.set(x, y);

    return t;
}

export default defineDemo({
    size: [W, 520],
    background: 0x050508,
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        // 1. hero light: three hourglass layers with layer blur 100, 55 and 24, as in the Figma file
        const hero = new Container();
        const heroBg = new SilkGraphics();
        const beam = new SilkGraphics();
        const heroClip = new SilkGraphics();

        heroBg.roundRect(0, 0, W, 240, 18, 0.6).fill(0x05031a);
        heroClip.roundRect(0, 0, W, 240, 18, 0.6).fill(0xffffff);
        beam.mask = heroClip;
        hero.addChild(heroBg, beam, heroClip);

        // 2. chromatic wave
        const wavePanel = new Container();
        const waveBg = new SilkGraphics();
        const wave = new SilkGraphics();
        const waveClip = new SilkGraphics();

        waveBg.roundRect(0, 0, 370, 260, 18, 0.6).fill(0x0b0b0c);
        waveClip.roundRect(0, 0, 370, 260, 18, 0.6).fill(0xffffff);
        wave.mask = waveClip;
        wavePanel.addChild(waveBg, wave, waveClip);
        wavePanel.position.set(0, 260);

        // 3. the bolt cut into strips, each smeared sideways
        const speed = new Container();
        const card = new SilkGraphics();
        const strips = 14;
        const top = 58;
        const bh = 154;
        const paint = linear(
            [
                [0, 0xffc2a8, 1],
                [0.4, 0xe05bd0, 1],
                [1, 0x6a3df0, 1],
            ],
            { from: [1, 0], to: [0.15, 1] },
        );
        const arts: SilkGraphics[] = [];
        // the white core is brightest in the middle and lets the colour fringes show at the ends
        const core = along([
            [0, 0xffffff, 0.35],
            [0.5, 0xffffff, 1],
            [1, 0xffffff, 0.35],
        ]);

        card.roundRect(0, 0, 370, 260, 18, 0.6)
            .fill(0x0f0d0f)
            .roundRect(10, 10, 350, 240, 12, 0.6)
            .fill(
                radial(
                    [
                        [0, 0x241821, 1],
                        [1, 0x120f12, 1],
                    ],
                    { center: [0.55, 0.5], radius: 0.7 },
                ),
            )
            .stroke({ width: 1, color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.05, alignment: 'inside' });
        speed.addChild(card);
        for (let i = 0; i < strips; i++) {
            const art = new SilkGraphics();
            const clip = new SilkGraphics();
            const y = top + (i * bh) / strips;

            clip.rect(10, y, 350, bh / strips).fill(0xffffff);
            art.mask = clip;
            art.blendMode = 'add';
            speed.addChild(art, clip);
            arts.push(art);
        }
        speed.addChild(
            label('Test sample #07', 26, 24, 0x6b5866),
            label('Render complete', 344, 24, 0xd9a0b8, 1),
            label('Speed mode: ON', 26, 226, 0x6b5866),
            label('Render time: 400 ms', 344, 226, 0x6b5866, 1),
        );
        speed.position.set(390, 260);

        stage.addChild(hero, wavePanel, speed);

        tick((t) => {
            const breathe = 1 + Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.06;

            beam.clear();
            hourglass(beam, W / 2, 150, 900, 300 * breathe, 30).fill({ color: 0x6a4cff, blur: 50 });
            hourglass(beam, W / 2, 150, 860, 220 * breathe, 14).fill({ color: 0xa48bff, blur: 27 });
            hourglass(beam, W / 2, 150, 820, 120 * breathe, 4).fill({ color: 0xece6ff, blur: 12 });

            const pts = (dy: number) => {
                const out: number[] = [];

                for (let x = -20; x <= 390; x += 5) {
                    out.push(x, 128 + dy - Math.sin(x / 75 + 1.2 + t * 0.8) * 46 + x * 0.04);
                }

                return out;
            };
            const smooth = { smooth: 'catmull' as const };

            wave.clear()
                .polyline(pts(0), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 90, color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.12, blur: 36, blend: 'add' })
                .polyline(pts(-19), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 9, color: 0xff2a14, alpha: 0.95, blur: 3.5, blend: 'add' })
                .polyline(pts(-12), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 9, color: 0xff9a1a, alpha: 0.95, blur: 3, blend: 'add' })
                .polyline(pts(13), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 9, color: 0x2a62ff, alpha: 1, blur: 3, blend: 'add' })
                .polyline(pts(0), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 20, gradient: core, blur: 2.5, blend: 'add' })
                .polyline(pts(0), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 34, gradient: core, alpha: 0.45, blur: 9, blend: 'add' });

            arts.forEach((art, i) => {
                // longer smears in the middle of the bolt, a slow ripple through the strips
                const f = i / (strips - 1);
                const smear = 30 + 70 * Math.sin(Math.PI * f) * (0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 2.4 + i * 0.7));

                art.clear();
                for (let k = 3; k >= 0; k--) {
                    bolt(art, 150 - smear * (k / 3), top, 120, bh).fill({
                        gradient: paint,
                        alpha: k === 0 ? 0.9 : 0.22,
                        blur: { from: 0.6 + k * 2, to: 10 + k * 6, angle: Math.PI },
                    });
                }
            });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

The beam is a pinched path drawn three times with less blur each time. The wave is a white stroke
with red, orange and blue copies a few pixels off. The bolt is one shape cut into strips, each
moved sideways.

Live demo `glow-aurora` (source):

```ts
import { Color, Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { Aurora, hexLabel } from 'pixi-silk/glow';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

/** The palette colour itself, lifted towards white when it is too dark to read on the chip. */
const readable = (c: number) => {
    const [r, g, b] = new Color(c).toArray();
    const lift = Math.max(0, 0.45 - (0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b)) * 1.6;

    return new Color([r + (1 - r) * lift, g + (1 - g) * lift, b + (1 - b) * lift]).toNumber();
};

const PALETTES: [number, number, number][] = [
    [0x6f1bff, 0xee36ff, 0xffffff],
    [0x1e06bb, 0x00c8ff, 0xffffff],
    [0x0ecd00, 0xaeff00, 0xffffff],
];

export default defineDemo({
    size: [760, 470],
    background: 0x1c1d22,
    controls: {
        rise: { type: 'range', label: 'rise', min: 0.3, max: 0.9, step: 0.01, value: 0.62 },
        speed: { type: 'range', label: 'speed', min: 0, max: 3, step: 0.1, value: 1 },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const auroras = PALETTES.map((colors, i) => {
            const x = 40 + i * 240;
            const phone = new Container();
            const frame = new SilkGraphics();
            const aurora = new Aurora({ width: 200, height: 330, radius: 30, colors, ticker: silk.app.ticker });

            frame
                .roundRect(-10, -10, 220, 350, 38, 0.6)
                .fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.45, blur: 18 })
                .roundRect(-10, -10, 220, 350, 38, 0.6)
                .fill(0x2a2b31)
                .stroke({ width: 1, color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.08, alignment: 'inside' });
            phone.position.set(x, 30);
            phone.addChild(frame, aurora);
            stage.addChild(phone);

            colors.forEach((c, j) => {
                const chip = new Container();
                const bg = new SilkGraphics();
                const label = new Text({
                    text: hexLabel(c),
                    style: { fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace', fontSize: 11, fill: readable(c) },
                });

                label.anchor.set(0.5);
                bg.roundRect(-33, -12, 66, 24, 7).fill({ color: c, alpha: 0.12 });
                chip.addChild(bg, label);
                chip.position.set(x + 34 + j * 70, 422);
                stage.addChild(chip);
            });

            return aurora;
        });

        tick(() => {
            for (const a of auroras) a.set({ rise: params.rise, speed: params.speed });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```
